title: Senior Shopify, Klaviyo & Design Specialist – Fashion Brand (Remote, Full-time)
description:
Senior Shopify, Klaviyo & Design Specialist – Fashion Brand (Remote, Full-time)



We are a European fashion brand selling to premium boutiques and department stores in Europe, the US and the Middle East. We're looking for an experienced all-rounder who can run our online presence from A to Z: technically, visually and commercially. You'll work independently and own your projects from start to finish.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Shopify (technical)

- Manage, build and customize our Shopify B2B wholesale store and our consumer store

- Edit themes and templates (Liquid, HTML, CSS), install and configure apps, and fix technical issues yourself

- Set up B2B features: company accounts, price lists, approvals, payment terms and checkout

- Build quick "mini-drop" pages (3–4 items) that retailers can order from instantly

- Automate workflows with Shopify Flow, and handle domains, DNS, integrations and tracking



 marketing

- Create, send and optimize Klaviyo campaigns and flows for wholesale buyers and consumers

- Build and maintain segments and lead lists, and report on opens, clicks and orders



Design

- Design
 templates, banners, landing pages, product visuals and social media graphics

- Place logos and brand assets correctly, prepare files for print and web, and keep everything on-brand

- Edit product photos: retouching, background removal and resizing



MUST-HAVES

- At least 5 years of hands-on Shopify experience, including theme customization and Liquid

- Proven Klaviyo experience: campaigns, flows and segmentation

- Strong graphic design skills in Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma or Canva, with a portfolio to show

- Solid technical skills: HTML/CSS, app integrations, DNS and troubleshooting

- Excellent written English and a sharp eye for detail

- Able to work independently and take full ownership

- Available Monday to Friday during CEST working hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Shopify B2B or wholesale experience

- Fashion or luxury brand background

- Experience with 
, monday campaigns or similar tools

- Basic photo or video editing for social media



HOW TO APPLY

Apply via this link: 



You'll be asked for your CV, links to at least two Shopify stores you built or customized, your design portfolio and a short description of a technical Shopify problem you solved.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Operations Manager, Fashion Dropship Niche
description:
READ THIS FIRST

THIS ROLE IS ONLY FOR PEOPLE WITH MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE IN FASHION DROPSHIPPING. NO EXCEPTIONS. Experience in other niches or in general e-commerce does not count. If you have not worked as a manager in a fashion dropshipping business, please do not apply.



About us

We are a fashion e-commerce company running multiple Shopify stores with a dropshipping business model. We currently work with a team of seven VAs. We are growing fast and plan to grow a lot further. For that we need the right people. We are looking for someone to grow with us long term, not for a short term job.



About the role

You lead our operations across customer service and supply chain. You manage people, build systems and make sure everything runs at a high standard. That means building SOPs, working on new sheets and thinking about automations (not necessarily building them). The day to day execution is done by our VA team. However, you will also jump in yourself when it gets busy and once the systems are in place. Doing the work yourself is how you see how things really work, where the mistakes are and what needs to be improved.



Customer service

Managing and training the team

Writing and improving SOPs and processes

Checking the quality of the team’s work

Keeping response times and quality high



Supply chain

Building out systems and sheets to keep the supply chain organised

Following up on order issues and shipping delays



Requirements (all are a must)

Proven experience as a manager in fashion dropshipping

Proven experience managing and training a team

Proven experience building systems and writing SOPs

Able to think about automations (you don’t need to build them)

Very precise and good at checking the quality of other people’s work

Excellent spoken and written English

A professional setup: good camera and microphone, quiet workspace, backup internet and power. 



Details

Full time, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week (Monday included)

Working hours: 16:00 to 00:00 Philippine time

Rate: to be discussed

Start: as soon as possible



How to apply

Only apply if you have experience as a manager in the fashion dropshipping niche.



Start your application with the words “Fashion Systems”. Then copy and paste the numbered questions below into your application and answer each one. Explain everything in as much detail as possible. Short or vague answers will not be considered.



How to apply

Only apply if you have experience as a manager in the fashion dropshipping niche.



Start your application with the words “Fashion Systems”. Then copy and paste the numbered questions below into your application and answer each one. Explain everything in as much detail as possible. Short or vague answers will not be considered.



1- What experience do you have? Explain your experience as a manager in fashion dropshipping.

2- What tasks did you do in your previous roles? Explain exactly what you did and what your work looked like.

3- Are you currently working somewhere else? For how long and why? Explain clearly why you left your last job. Also tell us when you can start.

4- Looking at this role, what is your expected hourly rate? Explain and support this expectation in detail.



Selected candidates will be invited for a video call.



If you read this and you know you do not fully match the requirements, please do not apply. It saves both of us time.

title: Technical Designer & Production Manager China – Luxury Fashion (monthly travel, all expenses paid)
description:
We are an international luxury womenswear label selling to more than 1,000 boutiques and department stores worldwide. Our production is growing fast: next season's volume will be about ten times higher. We are looking for a technical designer who will follow our production in China from A to Z, and be our eyes and voice on the ground.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Follow every order from A to Z: tech packs, fittings, samples, bulk production, quality control and shipment.

- Source fabrics, trims and new factories, and negotiate prices and lead times.

- Check that every factory follows our approved samples, measurements and tech packs.

- Keep factories on schedule, and flag any delay or quality issue immediately.

- Carry out quality inspections before shipment, and approve or reject goods.

- Work closely with our warehouse and logistics partner on shipments.

- Represent us locally, so we are treated as a respected client.

- Report every week on production status, risks and next steps.



TRAVEL

- You travel to China, mainly the Greater Bay Area, about once a month.

- You can fly at short notice when a factory needs a visit.

- 100% of travel costs are paid by us: flights, hotels, local transport and daily expenses.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 3 years of experience as a technical designer or production manager in womenswear, ideally in the luxury or premium segment.

- Hands-on experience with Chinese factories: sampling, bulk production and quality control.

- Strong knowledge of tech packs, pattern corrections, grading and fabrics.

- Sourcing experience: fabrics, trims and factories.

- Firm and diplomatic: you make sure deadlines and quality are respected.

- Fluent English. Mandarin or Cantonese is a strong plus.

- A valid passport, and able to obtain a Chinese visa.

- Willing to work with Hubstaff time tracking when working remotely.



WE OFFER

- A long-term, full-time position (40 hours per week), starting immediately.

- USD 3 per hour plus a bonus: around USD 1,000 per month in total.

- The bonus is paid for orders delivered on time and in the right quality.

- 100% of travel costs paid, from A to Z.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply via 

- Choose "Technical designer / production China" and upload your CV and portfolio.

- In "Tell us briefly about your experience", describe one production problem with a factory that you solved.

- Enter the code word FACTORY.

title: Marketing Operations Executor — US Healthcare Company (Remote) — 30-Day Full-Time Build, Then Part-Time
description:
Access Plus Health is a US healthcare compliance company founded by a Harvard-trained, board-certified physician. We are hiring a remote marketing executor for a 30-day full-time build phase, converting to part-time (20–25 hrs/week) once the build is done. This role is execution-focused: the founder sets strategy and provides AI-drafted content; you build, launch, manage, and report. You will work heavily with AI tools — we expect it — but you must be able to operate the platforms yourself, live.



What you will do:



1. Manage paid ads on Meta and Google from provided campaign structure: tracking setup (UTMs, pixel/CAPI), budget management, weekly reporting. Ads launch only after tracking is verified.



2.  Run outbound distribution: LinkedIn engagement and scheduling for the founder's account,
 group participation (Phase 1); webinar promotion and referral partner follow-up sequences (Phase 2)



3. Edit, format, and publish SEO articles from AI-assisted drafts (all content physician-reviewed before publishing) — ongoing cadence of 2/week is Phase 2 scope; Phase 1 focuses on the attribution/sequence/reactivation/ads build



4. Build and manage
 campaigns and automations in GoHighLevel from provided sequence specs (new-lead follow-up, reactivation, newsletter)



5. Maintain CRM hygiene and produce a weekly one-page report: leads, cost per lead,
 metrics, pipeline contribution





Requirements: 

- 5+ years marketing execution for US clients — you have personally run paid campaigns and built marketing automations at real volume, not coordinated a team that did; 

- hands-on GoHighLevel (or HubSpot/ActiveCampaign + fast GHL ramp); 

- personally managed Meta/Google campaigns including tracking; 

- excellent written English; fixed daily overlap hours with US Eastern, with same-day response on urgent items during that window (in writing in the offer).



Compensation — two phases, both stated here. This is a remote, globally-sourced role, and the rate below reflects an international market rate rather than a US-based salary.



Phase 1 (Days 1–30, full-time build): $1,200–$2,000/month based on experience — roughly $7–$12/hour. Default length is 30 days; may finish sooner for a strong performer with no reduction in the month's pay. Extends day-for-day at the full Phase 1 rate only if the delay is caused by APH (review turnaround, account access, portal) — not for candidate pace.



Phase 2 (Day 31 onward): part-time at ~20–25 hrs/week, with pay scaled proportionally from the Phase 1 rate and a small fixed daily overlap with US Eastern hours so urgent items still get a same-day response, both stated in writing.



Bonus: $150–$300/month on qualified-lead targets, carried through both phases and becoming a larger share of total pay once base hours drop.



Day-30 fork (APH's option, not a promise): if performance clearly warrants it, APH may keep this hire full-time at the Phase 1 rate with expanded scope folded in (CRM ownership, proposal support, follow-up sequencing) instead of converting to part-time.



Paid live working session before hire. 



To apply: resume, 2 writing samples, 1 campaign you personally managed (with numbers), and the word "COMPLIANT" first in your application

title: Medical Credentialing & insurance contracting Specialist -Behavioral Health
description:
Medical Credentialing & Insurance Contracting Specialist – Behavioral Health

Company: ClaimWise Billing Solutions

Job Type: Remote

Experience Level: Expert – Experienced Professionals Only

Job Description

ClaimWise Billing Solutions is seeking a highly experienced Medical Credentialing & Insurance Contracting Specialist to help our behavioral health clients obtain in-network contracts with commercial insurance companies, Medicaid, and Medicare.

This position focuses on securing individual provider, group practice, and facility-level insurance contracts, managing the entire process from initial application through contract execution and confirmed in-network status.

We are looking for a self-motivated professional who takes their work seriously, requires minimal supervision, and consistently follows through to completion.

Key Responsibilities

Required Qualifications



Extensive experience in medical credentialing and insurance contracting.



Proven success securing in-network contracts for providers, groups, or facilities.



Strong knowledge of behavioral health credentialing requirements.



Experience with commercial insurance networks, Medicaid, and Medicare.



Understanding of individual, group, and facility enrollment processes.



Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple clients and applications independently.

The Ideal Candidate

Is highly motivated, dependable, and professional.



Does not require constant supervision or reminders.



Is proactive, persistent, and resourceful.



Takes deadlines seriously and follows through on commitments.

Approaches challenges with a problem-solving mindset.



Takes pride in producing accurate work and delivering measurable results.

We value accountability, initiative, and a strong work ethic. We want someone who treats our clients' success as a priority, not someone who simply submits applications and waits for responses.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and answer the following questions:



How many years of medical credentialing and insurance contracting experience do you have?

title: Process Ownership Role
description:
We are not hiring experience. We are hiring a way of thinking.



JABO REI is a US real estate investment firm. Our hardest problems are document problems: files that don't add up, records that contradict each other, processes that stall for reasons nobody has named. We will teach you our domain — property, probate, paperwork — from zero. What we can't teach is the instinct we're hiring for, so this posting describes the instinct, not the résumé.



The work



You will take ownership of one document-heavy process end-to-end: our probate packet pipeline — the document set that moves a property from signed agreement to a filed court case. Owning it means three things: run it to a standard, find out why it stalls when it stalls, and rebuild the standard so it stalls less. You will work from primary sources — court records, county records, signed documents — and your work is judged on whether it is proven, not whether it is filled in.



You will thrive here if this sounds like you:



- When two documents disagree, you can't rest until you know which one is wrong, and why.

- You ask the third question — the one after the obvious follow-up — because the second answer still didn't explain the first.

- You can tell the difference between "it's written down" and "it's verified," and the difference bothers you.

- When nobody knows the answer, you go read the source material and build one, instead of waiting to be told.

- You write clearly enough that someone else could retrace your reasoning step by step.

- Being wrong early, in the open, is fine with you. Bluffing is not.



Please don't apply if:



- You prefer a fixed script and a supervisor's answer for every exception.

- "Probably fine" has ever been your final check on anything important.

- You need the task list complete and unambiguous before you can start.



Background: none required in real estate, title, or law. Our best-fit people come from audit, quality assurance, research, bookkeeping, troubleshooting, teaching, engineering — anywhere the real job was figuring out why something was actually wrong. A degree helps you not at all unless the habits above came with it.



Pay and process: $5/hr starting, flexible based on skill level — the assessment process is how we see where you land. Remote; hours set with the role.



How hiring works here (same for everyone, no exceptions):



1. Answer the application question below.

2. A personal packet: your résumé plus a free DISC assessment.

3. Two timed online tests — one aptitude, one curiosity. We hire from these results more than from résumés.

4. Interview.



Application question (required): Tell us about a time the stated problem turned out not to be the real problem. What was the clue that the first explanation was wrong, and what did you do about it? Specifics, please — vague answers are how we screen out.



— JABO REI

title: Bilingual Admin VA (English/Spanish) — Vehicle Rental Company
description:
About us



FastLane Hustle Rentals is a vehicle rental company in South Florida. We rent cars on 28-day renewable terms to gig-economy drivers — Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Amazon Flex, Instacart — across three counties. Our customers are working drivers. The car is how they feed their family, so this work is fast, personal, and it matters.



We are a small, tight team. There is no call center behind you. Everything runs through one system (GoHighLevel), and everything gets logged.



The role in one sentence



Every Spanish-speaking lead that comes into FastLane is yours — from the first phone call, through the rental, through every renewal after that.



This is not a script-reading appointment-setter job and it is not a back-office data-entry job. You are the entire customer relationship for a whole segment of our business. If you are good at this, you will have your own book of accounts that you personally built.



Why Spanish is required



A large share of South Florida gig drivers speak Spanish as their first language, and right now those leads do not get the same attention as our English leads. That is the gap you are filling. Our sales script is maintained in Spanish as well as English.



You need to sell, calm someone down, and chase a late payment — all in Spanish, on the phone, with a real person. This is not "some Spanish would be nice." Textbook Spanish will not survive the first call.



Part 1 — You own the lead

Take the inbound call. Leads come in through our system. You call them back fast. Speed is most of the job.

Qualify. Is the driver 25 or older, living in our service area, already approved and active on at least one gig app, and looking for a month or more? If they are not yet approved on a platform, they cannot finish — you tag the lead and set a callback instead of running the pitch.

Discovery. Which apps they run, how long they have been driving, what they are trying to solve.

Present the program. One flat weekly price that includes the car, the coverage, the taxes, unlimited miles, and maintenance. No deposit, no credit check.

Quote the car. Off our live availability sheet, built up in a specific order that we will train you on. There is a right way and a wrong way to say the number, and the wrong way loses the deal.

Send the exact car. Photos of that specific vehicle on our lot, by text. Everything after this happens in that thread.

Collect two things. A photo of their driver's license through our secure link, and proof of their active gig platform. Nothing else on the call.

Hand off for screening, then call the customer back the same day with the approval and a pickup time. That callback is the close. If it slips, the lead is gone.

Get the paperwork signed and the pickup booked.

Part 2 — You keep the customer



Once your customer has the keys, they stay yours:



Renewals. Every rental renews on a 28-day cycle. Seven days out you call and confirm: extending or returning? Log it the same day.

Payments. Verify the weekly payment landed. When one is missed, you contact the customer daily. Unresolved at 72 hours, you escalate to management — you document, you do not decide enforcement.

Weekly tolls. Every Monday, pull the prior week's tolls, match each one to the right customer, and invoice it.

Problems with the car. Gather the details and dispatch to our Fleet Coordinator. You do not diagnose vehicles.

Returns. Coordinate the return and get the car back on the availability board fast. An idle car earns nothing.

Notes. Every call, every commitment, every next step goes into the system. Our rule: if it is not logged, it did not happen.

Hard rules you will be trained on



These are legal and safety boundaries, not preferences. We check them.



No money on the phone. Ever. No deposit, no reservation fee, no card number. The first payment happens at pickup, in person. South Florida drivers are primed against rental scams — asking for money on a call kills the deal and reads as fraud.

You never give coverage advice. We are not an insurance agency and you are never the agent. If someone asks whether a specific situation is covered, the answer is always "let me confirm that and follow up," then you escalate. Saying the wrong thing here is a legal problem, not a sales problem.

You never promise income. Not to a driver, not to a vehicle owner.

You never change the price or the terms. Rates come off the sheet. Exceptions require written approval.

You never skip a screening step. Every step exists because something went wrong once.

When in doubt, escalate. "Let me confirm that for you" is always an acceptable answer here.

Requirements

Fluent, natural Spanish and English, spoken and written. You will be selling and collecting in both, by phone, every day.

Real phone confidence. You will make outbound calls to strangers, present a price, and ask for a commitment. You will also call people about money they owe. If that drains you, this is not your role.

Available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern Time. Non-negotiable — it is when our customers and our office are awake. Check what that is in your local time before applying.

Reliable phone and internet. Minimum 10 Mbps down / 5 Mbps up, a backup connection, a quiet room, and a quality headset. Background noise on a sales call costs us deals.

Organized under load. You will carry dozens of open files at once, each on its own clock, with callbacks that cannot slip.

Follows a process exactly. We need someone who works the system, not someone who improvises.

Long-term. This is a permanent seat, not a short project.

Nice to have (not required)

Phone sales, inside sales, retention, collections, or account management experience

Experience with GoHighLevel, or any CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce)

Experience with a US-based company — especially automotive, rental, logistics, or fleet

Google Sheets



What we offer:

$7.00 USD/hour, paid twice monthly on the 1st and 15th

Full-time, stable, long-term work with a company that is growing its fleet

Paid training, a written script, and SOPs for every step

Direct access to the owner — no layers, no bureaucracy

Real ownership of a segment of the business, with room to grow into a senior seat as we scale



Do not apply if:

Your spoken Spanish or English is not genuinely conversational

You are uncomfortable selling or asking for a commitment on the phone

You cannot commit to US Eastern business hours

You are looking for part-time or short-term work, or juggling several other clients



FIELD: HOW TO APPLY / APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



I read every application that follows these steps. I delete every one that does not.



1. Put this exact phrase in your subject line: FASTLANE-ES



2. Answer these three questions in your message:



What time is 9:00 AM US Eastern in your local time, and can you work through 6:00 PM Eastern every weekday?

Tell me about a time you sold something over the phone, or convinced a hesitant customer to commit. What did you say?

Where did you learn Spanish, and how often do you currently speak it?



3. Record a voice sample and share the link (Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo). About two minutes total, unscripted:



First 30 seconds, in English: introduce yourself and describe your work setup and internet connection.

Next 45 seconds, in Spanish: you are calling a driver named Carlos who asked about renting a car for Uber. Introduce yourself and the company, find out which apps he drives for and how long he has been driving, and ask for the appointment.

Last 45 seconds, in Spanish: same Carlos, three weeks later. His weekly payment was due two days ago and has not come through. Be polite, be clear, and get a commitment on when he will pay.



The Spanish recordings are the most important part of this application. Please do not use AI voice generation, a word-for-word script read, or a translation tool. I will be able to tell, and it is an automatic no.



4. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net).



Shortlisted applicants get a short video interview with me directly.

title: Part-Time Video/Podcast Editor: Interview Content for Executive Coaching Brand
description:
About

I run a boutique executive career strategy practice, working 1:1 with senior leaders, VP through C-suite, during career transitions. I record long-form interviews with clients and leaders, and I need an editor to turn each one into polished content for my website and social channels.



What you’ll do (per interview)



Edit the full recording into one long-form piece for my website, with clean audio, a simple branded intro and outro, and captions.

Create 5–8 short vertical clips (30–90 seconds) with captions for LinkedIn and Instagram.

Pull 3–5 short quotes from the conversation for text or graphic posts.

Deliver a cleaned-up transcript.



Editing approach

These are real conversations, so the raw recordings run long. Your job is to find the story inside them.



Cut the recording down to a tight 20–30 minute edit. Keep the moments with insight, honesty, or a clear point of view. Cut tangents, repetition, setup chatter, and anything that drags.

Remove filler words, long pauses, and false starts.

The finished piece should feel like a focused, intentional conversation, not a trimmed recording.

Clips should stand alone. Someone scrolling LinkedIn should understand and feel each one without any context.



How files are shared

I record in Riverside. I’ll send you the raw separate tracks and transcript through a shared Google Drive folder, and you’ll deliver finished files to the same folder.



Requirements



Proven experience editing podcasts or interviews. Please include links to your work.

Comfortable with AI-assisted tools such as Descript, Opus Clip, CapCut, or Premiere.

A good eye for which moments carry a conversation. The tone is professional, calm, and senior-level, not hype.

Strong English comprehension. Speakers are native English speakers.

Reliable turnaround of 5–7 days per interview.



Scope and pay



Paid per interview, as a fixed fee covering everything listed above, plus one round of revisions.

Each raw recording is up to 45 minutes.

There are 3–4 interviews ready to start, then about 1–2 per month ongoing.

The first interview is a paid test project.



To apply

Start your application with the word “SIGNAL” so I know you read this. Then include:



Links to 2–3 interview or podcast edits you’ve done, ideally with short clips.

The tools you use.

Your rate per interview for the scope above.

One sentence on how you d
 which moment in a conversation is worth clipping.

I'm the founder of OnePivot, a U.S.-based executive career strategy business that works with accomplished senior leaders and executives navigating their next professional chapter.

- Researching LinkedIn profiles of Senior Directors, VPs, SVPs, and C-suite executives.

Who I'm Looking For

Ideally, you have experience in one or more of the following areas:

- LinkedIn research and prospect sourcing.

- Recruiting, talent sourcing, or executive search research.

- B2B lead research involving senior-level decision-makers.

- Researching companies, leadership teams, and professional backgrounds.



You should also have:

- Excellent written English.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Good judgment and critical thinking skills.

- Experience using LinkedIn and Google Sheets.

- Comfort using AI tools to support research and organization.

- The ability to follow a defined process while recognizing when something requires further investigation.

- A reliable internet connection and the ability to work independently.



What This Role Is NOT

This is not a high-volume lead scraping or automated outreach position.

I'm not looking for someone to simply generate large lists of names.

Quality, relevance, and thoughtful research are much more important than volume.

You will not be responsible for sales calls, closing clients, or managing my social media.

I'm looking for someone who enjoys research, pays attention to details, and wants to develop a long-term working relationship.

title: Junior Structural Engineer
description:
Junior Structural Engineer | Work From Home | Training and Mentorship Provided



Company: Kiras Engineering Ltd.

Location: Philippines — fully remote

Schedule: Canadian team hours, 6:00 PM–4:00 AM Philippine Time

Benefits: Paid vacation and health benefits



Build your structural engineering career with a Canadian engineering firm.



Kiras Engineering Ltd. is looking for a junior structural engineer based in the Philippines to join our team for a long-term opportunity.



You will help review shop drawings, design post-frame buildings, and complete structural design for residential projects. As your knowledge and capabilities develop, your role can grow to include more complicated commercial, industrial, and institutional projects, with opportunities to progress into intermediate and senior responsibilities.



Previous work experience is an asset, but it is not required. We welcome recent graduates with strong structural engineering fundamentals, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.



What matters most



We are looking for someone who understands the engineering behind the calculations: how loads move through a structure, how supports and connections affect behaviour, and whether an analysis result makes sense.



You should have a solid foundation in:



Statics, equilibrium, and free-body diagrams.



Load paths and the behaviour of structural systems.



Structural analysis, support conditions, and boundary conditions.



Material properties and the behaviour of structural members.



Basic strength, stability, and deflection concepts.



You do not need to know Canadian codes or timber design before joining. We can teach those skills on a strong foundation.



What you will do



Review shop drawings for consistency with project drawings and engineering requirements.



Complete structural calculations and assist with the design of post-frame buildings and residential structures.



Prepare clear calculation packages, drawing markups, and written review comments.



Check your work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.



Identify missing information, ask questions, and flag concerns early.



Apply feedback and gradually take on more responsibility as your skills develop.



Your work will be completed under engineering supervision, with review and guidance as you learn.



Who will do well in this role



You are someone who:



Notices small details and checks your work carefully.



Is comfortable with repetitive, detailed tasks and maintains accuracy throughout.



Has a strong understanding of structural engineering fundamentals.



Is reliable, meets commitments, and communicates early when something may be delayed.



Takes responsibility for mistakes and follows through on corrections.



Writes clear, understandable English, including technical questions and review comments.



Is comfortable asking for help when something is unclear.



Can consistently work the required Philippine evening and overnight schedule.



Wants to develop a long-term career in structural engineering.



Qualifications



A degree in civil engineering or structural engineering.



Strong foundational knowledge of structural engineering.



Good written English communication skills.



A suitable home working environment with reliable internet.



The following are assets, but are not required:



Previous structural engineering experience.



Experience working on Canadian or other North American projects.



Wood/timber design or post-frame building experience.



Shop drawing review experience.



Familiarity with structural analysis software and CAD.



Training and mentorship



You will work under Kiras’s founder and receive direct day-to-day supervision and mentorship from an experienced member of our Philippine team based in Manila, who has worked with Kiras for more than two years in this role.



You will have opportunities to ask questions, receive feedback, and learn the reasoning behind design decisions. As you demonstrate sound judgement and reliable work, you will take on increasingly challenging projects.



What we offer



A fully remote position.



Paid vacation and health benefits.



Direct mentorship and practical structural engineering training.



Experience working on Canadian building projects.



Opportunities to grow into intermediate and senior responsibilities.



A team that values clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and quality work.



How to apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your résumé and a short message answering the following:



Why are you interested in structural engineering and this position?



Which structural engineering subjects do you understand best, and which would you like to strengthen?



Describe a situation where careful attention to detail helped you catch an error. An example from school is welcome.



Confirm that you can consistently work from 6:00 PM–4:00 AM Philippine Time.



Provide your expected monthly compensation in PHP and your earliest available start date.



If available, include a sample of your structural calculations, an academic design project, or relevant professional work that you have permission to share.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a brief technical assessment focused on structural engineering fundamentals.



Experience is welcome. Strong fundamentals, careful work, and accountability are essential.

title: Executive Assistant / Operations Assistant
description:
I am looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to support me across both my businesses and personal life.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role where you will simply be given a checklist of repetitive tasks. I am looking for someone who can become a trusted extension of me — someone who is thoughtful, highly organized, resourceful, comfortable using AI, and able to take ownership of tasks from beginning to end.



I own and operate multiple learning centers in the United States that keep me very busy. My days move quickly, and I need someone who can help bring structure, follow-through, and can communicate very well across many different areas.



The right person will be trusted with sensitive information and will often communicate directly with parents, employees, vendors, and other stakeholders on my behalf. Judgment, discretion, and written communication are therefore extremely important.



What You Will Help With

1. Executive & Personal Support

Manage and organize my calendar

Schedule appointments, meetings, travel, and personal bookings

Research options and make thoughtful recommendations

Complete forms and administrative paperwork accurately

Track deadlines, follow-ups, renewals, appointments, and important dates

Help manage personal projects and miscellaneous tasks

Maintain organized records and documentation

Follow up with people so things do not fall through the cracks



2. Inbox & Communication Management

Help manage a high-volume email inbox

Identify what is urgent, what needs my attention, and what can be handled independently

Draft thoughtful emails in my voice

Respond to routine emails on my behalf once trained

Follow up with parents, employees, vendors, leads, and partners

Maintain a professional, warm, and thoughtful tone in every interaction

Ensure important conversations receive timely follow-up



3. Learning Center / Business Operations

You will support several learning centers and may help with:



Parent communication and follow-ups

Enrollment and lead follow-up

Scheduling and appointment coordination

Vendor communication

Staff scheduling and administrative follow-ups

Tracking operational tasks across multiple locations

Updating spreadsheets, documents, and internal trackers

Preparing reports and organizing information

Following up on invoices, payments, contracts, and paperwork

Helping organize marketing initiatives and community outreach

Maintaining confidential student, family, employee, and business information

Identifying problems before they become bigger problems

Manage our social media platforms. Create relevant content and post regularly.



You do not need previous learning center experience. I care much more about how quickly you learn, how carefully you work, and how much ownership you take.



What I Am Looking For



You will likely be a great fit if you are:



Extremely detail-oriented: you notice names, dates, numbers, attachments, deadlines, and inconsistencies

An excellent written communicator: your English should be polished, natural, warm, and professional

A problem solver: when something is unclear, you investigate and propose a solution rather than immediately asking what to do

Highly trustworthy and discreet: you will have access to sensitive personal and business information

AI-forward: you actively use tools such as ChatGPT or similar AI platforms to research, draft, organize, summarize, and work more efficiently

Organized: you can manage many small moving pieces without losing track of them

Proactive: you follow up without being reminded

Comfortable with ambiguity: not every task will come with perfect instructions

Calm under pressure: you can handle an upset customer or an urgent request thoughtfully

Able to learn someone else's voice: eventually, an email written by you should sound like it came from me

Comfortable owning mistakes: if something goes wrong, I expect transparency and a proposed solution rather than excuses



Experience with some of these is helpful:

- Gmail

- Google Calendar

- Google Drive / Google Docs / Google Sheets

- ChatGPT and other AI tools

- Canva

- Social Media Platforms



Specific software can be taught. Strong judgment and attention to detail are much harder to teach.



Schedule: This position will begin at approximately 5 hours per day, Monday through Friday.



You must be willing to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with the US Eastern Time Zone.



For the right person, this role can become full-time after approximately three months.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow into a long-term role rather than simply pick up a few freelance hours.



Compensation: Compensation will be based on experience and demonstrated capability.



There will be an opportunity for increased responsibility, hours, and compensation for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



IMPORTANT: How to Apply



I receive many applications, so please do not send a generic cover letter.



Instead, include the following in your application:



Task 1 — Email Judgment



A parent emails:



“I’ve called your center twice and nobody got back to me. We came in for an assessment three weeks ago and were promised a call that evening. This feels extremely unprofessional.”



Draft the response you would send on my behalf.



Keep it under 200 words.



Task 2 — Problem Solving



Imagine I send you this message:



“I need to take my mother to a doctor next Thursday afternoon. Find me three well-reviewed options within 20 minutes of my home, check whether they take her insurance, determine their earliest appointment availability, and put everything in a format where I can quickly choose.”



In 5–8 bullet points, explain exactly how you would approach this task from beginning to end.



Do not simply say, “I would research doctors.”



I want to understand how you think.



Task 3 — Attention to Detail



At the very top of your application, write:



Math + Judgment + Ownership



Applications that do not include this line will not be considered.



Task 4 — AI



Tell me:



Which AI tools you currently use

One specific example of how AI has saved you time or improved your work

One situation where you would NOT trust AI's answer without independently verifying it



Task 5 — Your Work Style - Answer these briefly:



What type of manager brings out your best work?

Tell me about a time you caught a mistake before it became a bigger problem.

Tell me about a situation where you were given an unclear task and figured out what to do.

Are you comfortable working with confidential business and personal information?

What hours can you consistently work in US Eastern Time?



Please keep your entire application concise. Being able to communicate clearly without writing unnecessary paragraphs is part of the evaluation.



One Final Note



I care deeply about how people are treated.



Many of the people you will communicate with are parents trusting us with their children, employees relying on us for clear communication, or people with whom I have long-standing professional relationships.



Being fast is important.



Being accurate is important.



But being thoughtful, kind, and exercising good judgment is equally important.



If you are someone who takes pride in doing things exceptionally well, enjoys solving problems, and wants to become an indispensable part of a growing operation, I would love to hear from you.

title: AI Systems Architect
description:
Remote · Full-time · Eastern Time Schedule . ₱90,000–₱110,000/month + HMO + 10 days paid leave after 6 months,



About the role:



We're looking for a hands-on AI Systems Architect to design, build and run the AI foundation our whole organization will work on.



You'll shape how our teams and clients use AI agents day to day, so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on work that matters. This is a build role, not an advisory one. You'll write production code, make the architecture calls and set the standards others build on.

If you enjoy turning messy business workflows into reliable, secure AI systems, and you care whether they actually make people's work better, we'd like to hear from you.



What you'll do:



• Design our AI architecture. Set the standards for models, agents, orchestration, memory, tools, data access and human review.

• Build AI agents that work in production. Create agents, multi-agent systems and reusable services that teams can rely on.

• D
 what AI should and shouldn't do. Choose when work belongs to an AI agent, regular software, an automated workflow or a person.

• Set up how people work with agents. Define each agent's job, tools, permissions and escalation rules, and how people assign, review and accept its work.

• Keep things secure across clients. Design a multi-client setup that keeps each client's data separate and protects confidential information.

• Measure quality. Build evaluation and testing that tracks accuracy, reliability, cost, speed and rework, and catches hallucinations and bad recommendations.

• Guard against AI-specific risks. Handle prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized tool use, with clear audit trails and human approval where it counts.

• Turn business needs into working systems. Translate requirements into workflows, integrations and clear acceptance criteria.

• Lead and coach developers. Give direction, review work and help others build with the patterns you set.

• Solve the hard problems yourself. Stay close enough to the code to understand real effort and risk.



What you'll bring:



• Significant experience designing and shipping production AI systems

• A track record of building AI agents or multi-agent systems

• Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience with enterprise or platform architecture

• Practical experience with LLMs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval and orchestration

• Experience connecting AI systems to applications, databases, knowledge sources and APIs

• Experience building evaluation, testing and quality checks for AI

• Experience with authentication, permissions, audit logging and data protection

• Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI systems in production

• A history of turning business workflows into secure technical solutions and leading delivery

• Evidence that your work produced measurable improvements in operations, productivity or revenue

We don't require any particular framework, model provider or vendor. We care that you choose tools based on security, reliability, cost and business need.



Nice to have:



• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant platforms

• Experience building reusable AI products or platform capabilities

• Experience with knowledge architecture, semantic systems or advanced retrieval

• Experience in a growing company where systems and standards are still taking shape



How you work:



• You think in systems and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.

• You're open about your assumptions and blind spots, and you make uncertainty visible.

• You're comfortable making progress with incomplete information.

• You explain technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

• You take security, evidence, quality and human accountability seriously.

• You challenge assumptions constructively, including knowing when AI isn't the right answer.

• You care about outcomes, not just activity.

• You build systems others can use without needing you in the loop.



What success looks like:



• A secure, reusable AI architecture is in place and well understood.

• AI agents do approved work reliably, within clear permissions.

• Everyone knows what AI handles, what people review and when to escalate.

• Teams produce more useful work with less repetition and rework.

• AI costs, risks and performance are visible and under control.

• Developers deliver AI features faster using the patterns you set.

• Our AI capabilities deliver measurable benefits for the business and our clients.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an AI system you built and the results it delivered.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant & Financial Manager (Hospice & Healthcare)
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a high-caliber Philippine Licensed CPA, US Enrolled Agent (EA), or Senior US Tax Specialist to take full ownership of financial operations, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance for a growing portfolio of US healthcare and hospice entities, along with related commercial property holding companies.

In this role, you will lead complex multi-entity accounting in QuickBooks, maintain bank-ready financial records, manage global cash flow, and oversee complete federal and state tax filing processes. You will report directly to executive leadership to ensure our global financial presentation, balance sheets, and debt structures meet bank and credit committee underwriting standards.



Key Responsibilities

 US Federal & State Tax Management: Prepare, review, and manage federal (Form 1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S) and multi-state tax returns across our healthcare, hospice, and property entities, ensuring strict IRS compliance and relocation/multi-state tax planning.

 

Underwriting & Bank-Ready Financial Statements: Maintain precise, audit-ready financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and global cash-flow models to support commercial credit reviews, bank financing applications, and executive decision-making.

 

QuickBooks Administration & Cleanups: Direct chart of accounts setup, multi-entity account reconciliations, historical cleanups, and routine maintenance across QuickBooks Online and Desktop.

 

Healthcare & Hospice Operational Accounting: Manage granular expense tracking, operational budgets, revenue cycle workflows, and debt service tracking tailored to hospice and healthcare facility operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

 

Licensure / Credentials (Any of the following):

 Active Philippine Licensed CPA (PRC), OR

 Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) status, OR

 Passed US CPA Exam / Active US CPA License (Highly Preferred).

 

US Taxation & Underwriting Expertise: 3–5+ years of hands-on experience handling complex US federal/state returns, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance across multiple entities.



 Industry Focus: Direct prior experience in healthcare, hospice, medical practice, or commercial real estate accounting.

 QuickBooks Mastery: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Desktop (QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is a strong plus).

 

Technical Workspace Setup: High-speed internet with power backup, a dedicated quiet workspace, and strict adherence to handling confidential health and financial records.



How to Apply:



To apply, please submit your application with the following:



1. Updated Resume / CV detailing your direct experience with US tax filings, QuickBooks multi-entity management, and healthcare/hospice financial operations.



2. A brief summary highlighting:

 The specific US tax forms you have prepared (1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S).



 The number of healthcare, hospice, or property entities you have managed simultaneously.



3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

title: Case Management Administrator
description:
Job Type:

This role is permanent, subject to Philippine Labor Law’s Probation and Regularization standards.



Job Overview:





The Case Management Administrator provides administrative support to the Injury Management Team, with a 



primary focus on contacting clinics and healthcare providers to obtain medical notes and other documentation 



related to injured workers’ care. This position is responsible for documenting each contact attempt, tracking 



outstanding records, and ensuring received documentation is available to the assigned case manager for timely 



review.



The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable making frequent outbound calls, and persistent in 



following up on outstanding requests while maintaining a professional and courteous approach.



Responsibilities





Medical Records Requests and Follow-Up







• Contact clinics and healthcare providers to request visit notes, work status reports, test results, and other 



documentation requested by the case management team.



• Make timely follow-up calls when records have not been received, following established procedures and 



follow-up schedules.



• Confirm that the clinic has the correct contact information and delivery instructions for sending records.



• Clarify the status of outstanding requests, including when documentation is expected to be available.



• Notify the assigned case manager or supervisor of delays, difficulty obtaining records, or other issues 



requiring assistance.







Call Documentation and Tracking







• Document each call and contact attempt in Sourcelink.



• Include the date of contact, clinic or provider contacted, person spoken with, information requested, 



outcome of the call, and next follow-up needed.



• Maintain accurate tracking of outstanding records requests and scheduled follow-up activities.



• Ensure documentation is clear, complete, and entered promptly so the team can identify the status of 



each request.







Records Processing and Team Coordination







• Monitor designated channels for incoming records and match documents to the correct injured worker 



and case.



• Save and organize received records in the appropriate system or case file.



• Verify that received records correspond to the requested employee and visit date, and follow up on 



missing or incomplete documents.



• Notify the assigned case manager of any information obtained during the call.



• Refer clinical questions, treatment concerns, and information requiring nursing judgment to the 



appropriate clinician.







Administrative Support







• Monitor assigned work queues and prioritize calls and follow-up tasks based on established deadlines 



and team needs.



• Maintain confidentiality and handle employee information and medical records according to company 



policies and applicable privacy requirements.



• Support the team in meeting productivity, documentation accuracy, and turnaround expectations.



• Perform other related administrative duties as assigned.







Qualifications





• Previous experience in administrative support, healthcare operations, medical records, case management 



support, or customer service is preferred.



• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.



• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.



• Proactive in following up on pending items and resolving issues.



• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.



• Comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, spreadsheets,
, and web-based systems.



• Willingness to learn company procedures, systems, and workflows.



• Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.







Key Competencies







• Attention to detail and accuracy



• Time management and prioritization



• Accountability and ownership



• Problem-solving and critical thinking



• Professional communication



• Follow-through and consistency



• Adaptability and teamwork



• Confidentiality and integrity







Performance Expectations







The successful candidate will be expected to:







• Process assigned cases and orders accurately and within established timelines.



• Maintain consistent and timely follow-ups on pending items.



• Keep case records and tracking systems updated.



• Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.



• Recognize potential issues and escalate them appropriately.



• Demonstrate initiative, reliability, and accountability in completing daily responsibilities.







Ideal Candidate Profile







We are looking for someone who takes ownership of assigned tasks, pays close attention to details, and 



understands the importance of timely follow-ups. The ideal candidate does not simply wait for instructions but 



proactively identifies pending items, investigates discrepancies, communicates with the appropriate parties, and 



seeks guidance when necessary.







A strong candidate is dependable, organized, and committed to supporting the team in delivering accurate and 



timely service



What’s in store for you?

A Php 5,000.00 fixed night differential per month.



Work from Home allowance of Php 2,500.00 per month.



Work-Life Balance



Opportunity to shape and grow a training program that impacts real people



Collaborative and supportive team environment

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services
description:
Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services



We are looking for an experienced sales representative to join our team and sell home services to inbound leads.



This is not an entry-level sales position. We are looking for someone who already knows how to speak with homeowners, understand their needs, build trust quickly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.



You will be speaking with customers who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to turn those opportunities into booked and paid jobs.



Responsibilities:

Respond quickly to inbound phone, web, and other leads

Speak with homeowners about their project and understand exactly what they need

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Build trust and confidently guide customers toward purchasing

Handle common objections around price, timing, competitors, and project details

Follow up with leads who do not purchase immediately

Keep accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

Meet sales and conversion targets

Communicate with the operations team when needed to ensure a smooth customer experience



Requirements:

Previous sales experience is required

Strong preference for experience selling home services, construction, HVAC, landscaping, roofing, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, junk removal, materials, or similar services

Proven ability to close inbound leads

Excellent spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and professional working environment

Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools



What We're Looking For:

We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.



A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer, addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to move forward.



Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



Tell us about your previous sales experience.

What products or services have you sold?

Have you sold home services or worked with homeowners before?

Were the leads inbound, outbound, or both?

What were your typical sales targets or results?

Give us an example of how you would respond to a customer who says, "Your price is too high. I need to think about it."

Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Please speak naturally. We are using the video primarily to evaluate your communication skills, English, confidence, and sales ability, not your video production skills.



How to Apply



Send us:

Your resume

Your video introduction

A short description of your most relevant sales experience

The types of products or services you have sold

Any sales numbers, close rates, quotas, or other performance metrics you can share



Again, sales experience and the video introduction are mandatory. Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: Customer Support Manager (US Payroll, HR & Benefits Support Team)
description:
Customer Support Manager | Remote | Full Time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

(8:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time; 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM from November to March)



People who call our support line usually need a clear answer about something that matters to them: a paycheck, a benefit, a deadline, or an HR question. We're looking for a manager who gets that and can lead a team that answers with accuracy, urgency, and care.



ABOUT COLLABPEO

collabPEO is a US-based PEO (Professional Employer Organization). We handle payroll, employee benefits, HR support, compliance, and risk management for businesses, so they can focus on running their company.



THE ROLE

You'll lead a remote support team of about 10 to 20 people who answer questions from our clients (business owners and managers) and their employees. This is a people-leadership and operations role. You'll stay close enough to the calls to spot recurring issues, but your main job is building a strong team, keeping the queue covered, setting clear expectations, and improving the service experience.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead, coach, and develop a remote support team of 10 to 20 people

- Own daily operations: staffing, scheduling, and queue coverage for the full 8 AM to 5 PM ET window

- Set performance targets and track call quality, response time, resolution, CSAT, abandonment, and schedule adherence

- Run one-on-ones, team huddles, call reviews, and coaching sessions with direct, useful feedback

- Recognize strong performance early and handle performance or attendance issues fairly and consistently

- Build and improve SOPs, workflows, knowledge base articles, and escalation paths so the team can answer correctly without unnecessary transfers

- Work with our HR, payroll, benefits, and compliance specialists to fix recurring issues and keep the team updated

- Review call data and customer feedback, spot patterns, and bring clear recommendations to leadership

- Help with hiring, onboarding, and training as the team grows

- Make sure the team handles sensitive payroll and personal information with strict confidentiality



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 5 years of call center, contact center, or BPO experience

- At least 2 to 3 years as a Team Leader, Supervisor, or Manager handling 10 or more agents

- A track record of improving team KPIs and customer experience through coaching and clear processes

- Excellent spoken and written English, comfortable with US clients and US business culture

- Comfortable using call center data, QA scores, and customer feedback to make decisions

- Hands-on experience with call center, CRM, ticketing, or workforce management tools

- Organized, dependable, and calm under pressure when volume spikes or questions get complicated



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in a US PEO, payroll, HR services, or employee benefits account

- Experience supporting both business clients and their employees

- Experience managing a fully remote team



WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS

- Quiet, dedicated workspace suitable for calls and meetings

- Reliable primary internet (at least 25 Mbps) plus a backup connection

- Backup power (UPS or generator) for brownouts

- Noise-canceling headset and a computer that can handle calling and CRM tools at the same time



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clients and their employees see our support line as dependable, and the team finds it well run. Your agents know what's expected, get regular coaching, have the information they need to answer accurately, and know when to bring in a specialist. Leadership has a clear view of performance, recurring issues, and where service can improve.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any step below won't be reviewed.

1. Use this subject line: CSM2026 - [Your Full Name]

2. Attach your resume

3. Answer these two questions in your message:

   a. What was the largest team you managed, and which KPIs were you directly responsible for?

   b. Tell us about an agent whose performance you turned around. What did you do?

4. Include a 1 to 2 minute voice recording (link or file) introducing yourself and describing how you run a team huddle

title: CapCut Video Editor - YouTube Shorts Localization & Dubbing ($3 USD/Video)

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO | Strategic Partner Role
description:
Job Title: Executive Assistant to the CEO | Strategic Partner Role



Job Description:

Your Next Boss Wants You to Tell Him When He Is Wrong.

A U.S. real estate CEO is looking for the sharpest executive assistant in the Philippines. Not an order-taker. A strategic partner who anticipates problems, breaks down barriers and makes him better.

Full-time | Remote | 8:15am to 5:15pm US Central Time

Read this before you apply: most applicants will not pass our tests.

 That is on purpose. We are looking for one A+ player. If you are that person, you will read the next few lines and feel relieved that someone finally said it.

Who you are

 You are the smartest person in most rooms you work in. You are quick, highly organized, and a little bored by jobs that never ask enough of you. You have been the one who sees the problem coming and quietly fixes it before anyone else notices. You want a boss who can keep up with you, and a place where that is valued.

Who he is

 Our CEO is a 20-year real estate broker and investor who has been involved in nearly 2,000 transactions. He runs a growing U.S. real estate and lending group. He has more ideas, projects and
 than one person can handle. His time is the most valuable asset in the company, and too much of it goes to things that should never reach him.

What you will do

Take over his inbox. You read everything and handle what you can. Over time you reply in his voice, and he sees only what truly needs him.

Run his calendar and travel. Protected, prepared, and exactly right.

Turn one-line ideas into finished results. He hands you a sentence. You ask sharp questions, research it and bring back the answer.

Close the loose ends. Bills, follow-ups, documents and requests. Tracked until done.

Build the systems that prevent problems. You see what could go wrong and put structure in place first. You break down the barriers that eat his time.

The part most job posts leave out

 You will be asked to tell the CEO what he missed, what is wrong and where he should rethink. We do not want a complainer, and we do not want a yes-person. We want a strategic thinking partner who pushes back with a better idea and makes the work stronger. If you can do that, you will thrive here. If not, this is not the seat for you.

Who thrives here

You are wicked smart. You learn fast and connect dots without being walked through them.

You communicate excellently. You will write as the CEO, so your written English must be flawless.

You ask great questions. You read, you are curious, and your insight earns trust.

You do what you say you will do. Every time.

You have a history of high achievement at work and outside it. We want to know what you have stuck with and gotten great at.

You value relationships and you are people smart. You hear what someone is not saying.

You are a team player on a small team where your work is seen.

You want to be challenged and become the best version of yourself.

Your last boss would still call you for advice.

Our culture

 We hire and promote on five values: Credibility, High Achievement, Intellect, Relationships and People Smart. These are not wall posters. Every candidate and every team member is measured against them.

The long game

 This is not a stepping stone. We are looking for someone who wants a home, a place that could be the last job you ever take, decades from now. We invest in people who invest in us.

Requirements

Full-time US Central hours, long term

You use Claude or ChatGPT daily as a thinking partner, to pressure-test ideas, sharpen your writing and learn faster. Not to copy answers you do not understand. We want people who get smarter with it, not lazier.

Strong in Google Workspace

Reliable internet, backup power and a quiet workspace

Experience supporting a CEO or founder is a plus. Intelligence and judgment matter more.

This is not for you if you want a short-term job, a resume builder, or a role with fixed routines and detailed instructions for every task.

How to apply

 Send your resume.

What happens next

Online skills assessments 
 skills, attention to detail, executive assistant skills)

Personality profile. We hire for a specific profile, and it is a hard requirement.

Culture conversation with our COO

Interview with the CEO

Reference calls with people you reported to directly

Think you are the 1 in 100? Send your resume.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup
