title: Real Estate Cold Caller / Acquisitions Assistant — US Land Buyer (Long-Term, 30 hrs/week)
description:
Role summary



You will work directly for a US-based real estate investor (a principal buyer, not a brokerage) who buys vacant land lots in Panama City / Bay County, Florida under assignable contracts and assigns those contracts to local home builders.



Your job, in order:



1. Call US home-building companies and ask a short set of questions (script provided) to document exactly what lots they buy — their "buy box": areas, lot size, price range, deal-breakers, closing speed, and whether they accept contract assignments.

2. Log every answer in a shared tracker, exactly and completely. Your notes drive all later decisions.

3. Once buy boxes are captured, help find lot owners who match them (using provided tools and AI-assisted search/filtering) and call those owners to open a purchase conversation using a provided script.

4. Bring interested owners and clean documentation back to the owner. You never sign anything, never send contracts, and never promise a final price — the owner reviews, approves, and signs every contract personally.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants steady part-time work (30 hrs/week) with one employer, not agency hopping.



Pay



- $150 USD per week to start (paid weekly) — that's $5/hour for a 30-hour week.

- Performance bonuses:

  - $100 per purchase contract signed with a lot owner that you sourced and brought to the owner contract-ready.

  - $250 per closed deal (paid when the deal closes and the assignment fee is received).

  - Why these numbers: a typical Panama City lot deal in this program nets roughly a $3,000 spread, so the bonuses are sized to be meaningful to you without breaking the deal math — about 3% for a signed contract and about 8% for a closed deal.

- Pay review after 90 days based on results.



Hours



- 30 hours per week: 6 hours a day, Monday–Friday.

- Core calling hours are US Central Time: Tuesday–Thursday, 9–11 AM and 1–4 PM CT (builder offices). Those prime builder windows are the heart of the schedule — your Tue–Thu shifts are built around them.

- Monday is list building, research, and follow-up prep; Friday is follow-ups and wrap-up. Owner-outreach work joins the Tue–Thu blocks once buy boxes are captured.

- Note honestly: US Central daytime = Philippine night shift (roughly 10 PM–5 AM Manila during calling windows). Only apply if a night schedule works for you long-term.

- Weekends off.



Requirements



- Cold-calling experience (real estate, insurance, sales, or appointment-setting all count). This is the core skill — you must be comfortable dialing strangers, getting past gatekeepers, and handling brush-offs without taking it personally.

- Clear, easily understood spoken English. You will be talking to American builders and landowners in Florida. A neutral accent is fine; clarity and confidence matter more than sounding American.

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet, a good headset, and a computer that can run a web-based dialer and spreadsheets.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Drive, and basic web research.

- Detail discipline: you log calls the same day, exactly as answered — no summarizing away the important parts.

- Plus, not required: prior work for a US real estate investor or wholesaler; experience with dialers (Mojo, CallTools, Kixie, or similar); skip-tracing or property-data tools.



Who you will NOT be



- Not a licensed agent, and you must never present yourself as one.

- Not a broker: you only ever work on the owner's own contracts. You never offer to market or sell someone else's property for a fee. (This is a legal line — training covers it in detail.)



How to apply — the voice test is mandatory



Applications without the voice recording will not be read. This is deliberate: this role is 80% phone work, and the recording is the fastest honest filter for both of us.



Step 1 — Record yourself (phone voice memo is fine, 30–45 seconds) reading this opener exactly as written:



"Hey, my name's [your first name], I work with Adam Billiot here in Panama City. We find vacant lots around Bay County and put them under contract. Before we go hunting, I wanted to ask what you're actually looking for in a lot, so we only bring you stuff that fits. Got about five minutes?"



Step 2 — Answer these three questions in writing (short answers, your own words):



1. Tell us about your most recent cold-calling job: what were you selling or booking, how many dials a day, and what were your results?

2. A builder's receptionist says "We don't talk to wholesalers, and he's busy." What do you say next? (There is no single right answer — we want to see how you think on your feet.)

3. This is a night-shift role (Philippines time) calling Florida during US business hours. Confirm your setup: internet speed, backup plan for power/internet outages, headset, and quiet workspace.



Step 3 — Send: the audio file (or a link to it), your written answers, and your CV.



What happens next



1. We review the voice recording and written answers.

2. Finalists do a short paid trial task: a live mock call (role-play with us playing a builder) plus a sample tracker entry.

3. Top 3 candidates are presented to the owner with their recordings; he makes the final pick.

4. Hired VA starts with paid training (scripts, tools, legal guardrails) before any live calls.

title: Work From Home Senior Data Engineer (TypeScript / AWS, Retail Data) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$450 per week. Full-time.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (Australian Eastern Time / AEDT), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



An Australian retail analytics SaaS company is hiring a Senior Data Engineer who knows retail data inside out.



A retail analytics platform is only as good as the data underneath it. You will own bringing each fashion and retail customer's sales, stock and product data together: messy, inconsistent sources from ERPs, POS, ecommerce platforms, warehouses and spreadsheets, joined into a single trusted view that buyers and planners rely on every day.



This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You build and own data pipelines in TypeScript on Node.js, working with data in AWS S3 and DynamoDB rather than a traditional relational database. You are incredibly meticulous about accuracy and still move with urgency. You work hand in hand with the Customer Success Manager and the CS team to onboard new customers, resolve integration issues and keep data flowing cleanly.



If you cannot explain how you join dirty retail identifiers in code, design DynamoDB access patterns, and prove a reconciliation when numbers do not tie out, this role is not a fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build TypeScript ingestion and ETL pipelines that map and transform new customers' sales, stock, product and purchase order data into the platform

- Work through unclean and inconsistent source files and feeds, defining clear matching and business rules across systems

- Join messy retail data across sources in code: product hierarchies, SKUs, sizes, colours, stores and channels

- Resolve mismatched identifiers, duplicate records and gaps between ERP, POS, ecommerce and warehouse systems

- Design data models and access patterns for S3 and DynamoDB, writing clean, tested, well-documented TypeScript

- Reconcile outputs back to source systems and catch discrepancies before customers do

- Build checks and validation routines that protect accuracy at every load

- Partner with the Customer Success Manager to troubleshoot integration sources and data issues, investigate root causes and explain them clearly

- Support the CS team with technical guidance on data questions

- Spot recurring data patterns across customers and turn them into reusable logic

- Suggest improvements to pipelines, documentation and onboarding processes



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- Senior experience as a data engineer or backend engineer working with production data pipelines

- Strong experience with retail data, ideally across sales, stock and product

- Expert at joining data across unclean, inconsistent data sets

- Highly skilled in TypeScript and JavaScript on Node.js, building production data pipelines and ETL

- Hands-on with AWS, especially S3 and DynamoDB or other NoSQL / non-relational data stores

- Incredibly meticulous and careful with data accuracy, with a track record of reconciling outputs to source

- A strong sense of urgency, able to keep up the tempo without cutting corners

- Comfortable working with remote teams

- Able to work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April)

- Willing to share a GitHub link or code sample that shows real TypeScript / Node.js pipeline or ETL work



STRONGLY PREFERRED



- Fashion or apparel data experience: size curves, styles, colourways, seasons

- Exposure to retail ERP, POS, ecommerce and warehouse systems

- SQL for working with source systems and exports

- Other AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, Glue or Athena

- Processing large files (CSV, JSON, Parquet) and API integrations at scale

- Background in SaaS, analytics or merchandise planning



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with DE-450 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions or the code sample, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Include a GitHub link or other code sample that shows TypeScript / Node.js data pipeline or ETL work you have written (link in the application body).

3. Answer all three questions below in your application.

4. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$450 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A fashion retailer sends you product master data from their ERP and daily sales from their POS. The ERP uses style + colour + size codes (for example STY-100 / BLK / S). The POS uses a different SKU scheme and often truncates or remaps colour and size labels (for example 100-BLACK-SM vs STY-100-BLK-S). Some SKUs exist in sales with no product master row; some master rows never sell; sizes and colours are inconsistent across files. Walk us through how you would normalise and match these records in TypeScript on Node.js so sales can join cleanly to product. Cover at least: what keys and normalisation rules you would define, how you would handle unmatched or ambiguous rows, and how you would make the matching rules testable and reusable for the next retailer. Include a short code sketch (functions / types / matching steps are enough; full production code not required). Do not give a generic "I would clean the data and join on SKU" answer.



2. Design a daily ingestion pipeline for large retailer files (CSV or JSON) that land in AWS S3 and must be queryable for sales, stock and product by customer, date and store. You are using TypeScript on Node.js, S3 and DynamoDB (not a traditional relational warehouse as the primary store). Describe: the S3 layout and how a new daily file triggers processing; the DynamoDB table design and access patterns (partition / sort keys or equivalent) for the reads the product and CS teams need; how you would handle late files, re-runs and partial failures without double-counting; and what you would log or validate so a Customer Success Manager can see whether today's load is healthy. Name concrete trade-offs, not buzzwords.



3. Describe a real example where you found and proved a data discrepancy between a pipeline output and a source system (ERP, POS, ecommerce, warehouse or similar). What signal made you suspicious, how you investigated, how you proved which side was wrong (or how both were incomplete), what you changed in code or process, and how you stopped it recurring. Include approximate scale (rows, customers or dollars if you can) and the systems involved. Shallow "I checked totals and fixed a bug" answers will not pass.



Fluent English is required.

title: Media Buyer Agency Experience Required
description:
---DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE MEDIA BUEYR AGENCY EXPERIENCE AND HAVE NOT HANDLE $2M WORTH OF ADS ----





We aren’t looking for a “media buyer.” We’re looking for a growth architect. Someone who eats, breathes, and sleeps paid media. Someone who can see the entire chessboard of ads, funnels, and creative — and move the right piece at the right time to scale campaigns from six figures a month to multi-millions a month.



At Speak Your Way To Cash®, we’ve grown from zero to an Inc. 5000 company — and we’re just getting started. Our mission is to empower experts and entrepreneurs to turn their voices into revenue. Now, we’re looking for the person who will fuel that mission with the precision of a scientist and the heart of a strategist.



What You’ll Do:



Lead media growth across all platforms: Meta (FB/IG), YouTube, TikTok, Google suite, LinkedIn, and whatever platform drives ROI.



Architect and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously, including:



Awareness campaigns that dominate impressions.



Conversion campaigns that hit 1.5+ ROAS on the front end and 3+ ROAS on the back end.



Write powerful creative briefs: You’ll translate strategy into specific hooks, angles, and ad formats that designers, editors, and content producers can

execute on.



Set up, manage, and scale campaigns: from ad copy to targeting, from $1K tests to $1M scale.

Run thousands of creative tests to find the winning hook, iterate it into new variations, and push campaigns until they break records.



Analyze the data like a pro — not just looking at CTR and CPC, but uncovering the story behind the numbers and making fast, decisive adjustments.



Own funnel alignment: If the funnel is the bottleneck, you’ll spot it, flag it, and help the team fix it so growth doesn’t stall.



Forecast, report, and scale: You’ll know where our ad dollars should go, what’s driving growth, and where we double down.



Who This Role Is For



? A growth-driven strategist who thrives in high-stakes, high-reward environments.

? Someone who has scaled campaigns into the multi-millions per month — and is hungry to do it again.

? A creative thinker who can spot a winning hook, brief it out, and multiply it into hundreds of testable variations.

? Someone who sees analytics not as “reports” but as a roadmap to scale.

? A leader who can direct designers, video editors, and producers with clarity and confidence.

? Someone who wants to play on a team where their work directly drives seven- and eight-figure outcomes.

? A competitor at heart who isn’t satisfied with average ROAS — you push until the campaigns break records.



Who This Role Isn’t For:



? Someone who just wants to “manage ads” and clock out at 5.

? Someone who’s only run $10K–$50K campaigns and thinks that’s “big.”

? Someone who needs their hand held through creative strategy instead of leading it.

? Someone who looks at the numbers but can’t translate them into action.

? Someone who avoids accountability or blames “the algorithm” when ads don’t convert.



What You Bring



Proven track record: You’ve scaled paid campaigns to multi-millions per month in spend and returns.

Creative killer instinct: You know what hook will stop a scroll, what headline will convert, and how to turn an ad into a money-making machine.

Data-driven decisiveness: You don’t just “look at analytics,” you live inside them — pulling insights that others miss.



Leadership DNA: You can direct designers, video editors, and producers to bring your vision to life — fast.



Strategic vision + tactical chops: You can architect the strategy and then roll up your sleeves to launch, test, and optimize campaigns yourself.

Funnel awareness: You know an ad can’t save a broken funnel — and you’ll partner with the team to ensure nothing stands in the way of scale.

Relentless drive: You literally eat, breathe, and sleep media buying. You’re obsessed with finding the next big lever for growth.



Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary: Were willing to pay what it takes to get the best; base depending on experience.



Potential bonuses for the right candidate.



Work directly with a fast-growing Inc. 5000 company impacting experts worldwide.



A seat at the table where your ideas directly shape the future of our brand.



If you’ve been waiting for the chance to run media like you would for a Fortune 500 empire — this is it. At Speak Your Way To Cash®, we don’t play small. We’re scaling fast, we’re scaling smart, and we need the best in the game to lead our paid media growth.

Apply now. Show us how you’ve scaled, what you’ve built, and how you’ll take this brand to the next level.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement

Remote | Full-time |



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage).

Website: 
/

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.) High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.) Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.) Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

This is a senior seat with real ownership, not a data-entry role.



What you'll do

Prepare and review individual and business returns — 1040, 1120, 1120-S, 1065 — in Drake Tax

Serve as final technical reviewer; catch what others miss

Own tax workflow in TaxDome: pipelines, job templates, client tasks, document requests, e-signatures

Manage, train, and develop a team of preparers; assign work and hold the line on quality and deadlines

Handle multi-state filings, S-corp reasonable compensation, §199A, depreciation, and entity-level planning

Manage the season calendar — extensions, estimates, deadline tracking

Work directly with the founder on complex client matters and process improvement

What we're looking for

4+ years of hands-on US tax experience — preparation and review, not support

Expert-level Drake Tax. You know the software cold and can work in it at speed.

Expert-level TaxDome. You've built and run pipelines, job templates, and automations — not just clicked through someone else's setup.

Proven team leadership in an accounting or tax firm. You've managed preparers, reviewed their work, and been accountable for their output.

Deep command of US federal and multi-state tax law for small and mid-sized businesses

Excellent written and spoken English

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace

Who thrives here



You're hungry. You take ownership without being asked, you're direct about problems, and you want to build something rather than clock in. You care about getting the answer right, not just getting the return filed.



You want to grow — into a bigger team, a bigger scope, and a bigger role — at a firm that's growing fast enough to make that real.



Compensation and schedule

$2,000 USD per month + Annual Performance Bonus!

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Substantial overlap with US Eastern business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET)

How to apply



 
 with both of the following. Applications missing either item will not be reviewed.



Your resume

A 2–3 minute Loom video covering:

Who you are

Your tangible work experience — the firms, the return volume, the complexity you've handled

How large a team you've led, and what you were accountable for

Why you'd be a strong fit for this role

title: Remote Outbound Sales Representative – Website Sales
description:
Job Title: Remote Outbound Sales Representative – Website Sales



We’re hiring a reliable, English-speaking outbound sales representative to contact small businesses in the United States and sell affordable business websites.



Responsibilities



* Call potential customers using our provided leads.

* Introduce our $500 website service.

* Explain the benefits of having a professional business website.

* Present website demos to interested customers.

* Follow up with prospects and close sales.

* Record all calls, customer interactions, and lead statuses in our CRM.



Compensation



* Hourly pay: $5 USD per hour.

* Initial work allocation: 20 hours ($100 total base pay).

* Sales commission: 10% ($50) for each completed $500 website sale.

* Commission is additional to hourly pay.



Payment Conditions



* Hourly compensation is based on actual, approved hours worked and accurately recorded.

* The payment schedule and payment method will be agreed upon before work begins.

* Sales commissions are earned only after the customer has successfully paid for the website and the payment has been confirmed.

* Unpaid invoices, pending transactions, and canceled orders do not qualify for commission.

* Refunded or reversed transactions do not qualify for commission. Any adjustment to a commission already paid will be handled according to the written agreement and applicable law.

* Earned hourly wages will be paid regardless of sales performance, in accordance with applicable law.



Sales Conditions



* The standard website selling price is $500 USD.

* Representatives may not offer unauthorized discounts, payment plans, or additional services.

* Customers must pay through the company’s approved payment process.

* Representatives must never collect customer payments into personal accounts.

* All leads, customer communications, sales, and follow-ups must be documented in the company CRM.

* A sale is credited to the representative assigned to the customer, subject to the company’s documented sales attribution rules.

* Representatives must not promise features, delivery dates, or guarantees that the company has not approved.

* All outreach must comply with applicable U.S. telemarketing, privacy, and do-not-call requirements.



Performance Expectations



* Make consistent outbound sales calls during scheduled working hours.

* Follow up promptly with interested prospects.

* Present website demos professionally.

* Maintain accurate CRM records.

* Work toward converting qualified prospects into paying customers.

* Sales performance will be reviewed after the initial 20 hours. Continued work is subject to business needs and performance.



Requirements



* Excellent spoken English.

* Previous cold-calling or outbound sales experience.

* Confident, professional communication skills.

* Ability to handle objections and close sales.

* Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

* Availability during U.S. business hours.



Apply Now – Immediate Hiring!



We’re looking for a confident salesperson who can turn conversations into paying customers. If you have proven cold-calling experience, strong closing skills, and are ready to start earning hourly pay plus commissions, we want to hear from you!



To be considered, submit:



1. Your resume highlighting your sales experience.

2. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating your spoken English.

3. Your sales track record: Tell us about your previous cold-calling experience and the types of products or services you’ve sold.

4. Your availability: Confirm when you can start and whether you can work during U.S. business hours.

5. A short sales pitch: In 3–5 sentences, explain how you would convince a small business owner to purchase a $500 website.



Applications missing the requested information may not be considered.



Ready to prove your sales skills? Apply today! We’re reviewing applications for an immediate start.

title: Work From Home Merchandise Allocator (Fashion Retail) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$270 per week. Full-time.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (Australian Eastern Time), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



A well-established premium Australian womenswear brand, selling through its own retail stores and online, is hiring a Merchandise Allocator who owns allocation and replenishment day to day.



This is not an "upload and execute" role. You must understand and explain the drivers behind every allocation: how you seed a new collection, when consolidations make sense, and how you manage priorities with your Planning Manager. If you cannot walk through those fundamentals clearly, this role is not a fit.



You will report to the Planning Manager, work full-time from home on Sydney hours, and have a clear path into merchandise planning with a stable brand.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own model stock and replenishment across retail stores and ecommerce in the brand's retail ERP / merchandise system (the business runs on AP21; training is available if you have used a similar system)

- Allocate new seasonal collections from first drop through early replenishment, using store tiering, capacity, size profiles, last-season performance and planned intake, not gut feel alone

- Run ongoing allocations, store transfers and consolidations using rate of sale, sell-through, weeks cover, stock on hand, inventory age and broken size runs

- Spot and act on consolidation triggers early (trading data and seasonal / calendar events), and bring a clear recommendation to the Planning Manager rather than waiting to be told

- Turn weekly trade into actions: what to move, replenish, consolidate or mark down, and why

- Prepare weekly and monthly sales, stock and allocation reports that lead with insights and recommendations

- Balance warehouse deadlines, store replenishment pressure and manager requests without dropping the ball, and communicate trade-offs upwards

- Improve and automate manual reports and models where you can



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- Hands-on experience with a retail ERP or merchandise planning / allocation system (for example AP21 / Apparel21, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Cin7, Retail Pro, JDA / Oracle, or similar). AP21 itself is highly regarded but not required if you have done real allocation work in a comparable system

- Proven stock allocation experience with a fashion retailer, apparel brand or department store

- At least 1 year as an Allocator, Merchandise Assistant or similar inventory / allocation role in fashion, apparel or retail, with exposure beyond pure execution (trade analysis, recommendations, consolidations or markdowns)

- Can clearly explain how you approach allocating a new collection (inputs, sequence, hold-back for replenishment, hero vs slow styles)

- Can name the data points and seasonal events that trigger consolidations, with a real example

- Can manage upwards: prioritise under pressure and give the Planning Manager a decision-ready view

- Strong grasp of retail metrics: sell-through, weeks cover, stock turn, rate of sale, inventory age

- Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, formulas, reporting). Shortlisted candidates complete a short Excel analysis task

- Able to work independently, own outcomes end to end, and work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Direct AP21 / Apparel21 experience

- Building or refining store tiering, capacity or size-profile frameworks

- Allocating across both retail and ecommerce

- Automation skills (VBA, Google Apps Script or similar)

- Junior Planner or merchandise planning experience

- A passion for fashion and retail



THE RIGHT PERSON



You do not just push stock. You can explain the commercial logic: how a new collection gets seeded, what forces a consolidation, and how you protect bestsellers while clearing aged inventory. You read the numbers, recommend the next move, and keep your manager informed when priorities collide. You look for ways to improve the process rather than wait to be told.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with ALLOC-270 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Answer all three questions below in your application.

3. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm Sydney time (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$270 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A new seasonal collection has just landed in the warehouse and needs first allocation across retail stores and ecommerce before it goes live. Walk us through how you would approach that allocation from scratch. Cover at least: which data and inputs you would pull before you allocate a single unit (for example last season sell-through by store/style/size, store tiering or capacity, size curves, planned intake, ecommerce demand); how you would d
 depth by store vs holding back for replenishment; how you would treat hero styles vs slow movers; and what you would check in week one after the drop. Do not give a generic "I would look at sales and send stock" answer. Name the metrics and the sequence.



2. What events or data points would make you recommend consolidating stock (pulling from some stores / channels into others, or back to DC)? Give specific examples across both trading data (for example weeks cover, rate of sale, sell-through, inventory age, broken size runs, stockouts elsewhere) and calendar / seasonal events (for example end of season, promo window, new collection intake, store refit or closure). For one real example from your past role, say what you saw, what you recommended, who you took it to, and what happened.



3. It is Monday morning Sydney time. You have: (a) a new collection allocation that must leave the warehouse today, (b) three stores chasing urgent replenishment on bestsellers that are stocked out, and (c) your Planning Manager has asked for a clear recommendation on consolidating aged winter stock before a promotion next week, for a catch-up in two hours. How do you prioritise, what do you do first, what do you defer, and exactly how do you communicate upwards so the manager has a decision-ready view without you dropping the urgent store or warehouse work?



Fluent English is required.

description:

The journal combines motivational reading, self-reflection exercises, goal-setting activities, daily journalling and weekly reviews.

title: Clinical Content Dentist (MUST BE A DENTIST)
description:
Clinical Content Dentist



Remote | Part-Time (20 hours/week) / Full-Time (40 hours/week) | Flexible | MUST BE A DENTIST



Monthly Compensation



Starting salary will depend on your experience and whether you're joining us part-time or full-time. Following a successful probation period, your salary will increase to your regular rate. We also review compensation annually and reward strong performance through salary progression and discretionary bonuses as the business grows.



We're an independent dental education platform that serves thousands of dentists worldwide through our award-winning podcast, YouTube channel, online courses, webinars, and growing membership community.



We're looking for a curious, proactive, and clinically-minded Clinical Content Dentist to help us create engaging educational content and contribute to a thriving online community of dentists around the world.



This is a varied role that combines clinical knowledge, content creation, research, communication, and community engagement.



You'll use your clinical knowledge to transform research, webinars, podcasts, and real clinical discussions into educational content that helps dentists become better clinicians — while also helping us engage with and support the dentists in our community.



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We're looking for someone who can't help but think:



"That discussion would make a brilliant carousel."



"This five-minute section deserves its own YouTube video."



"This paper has one practical takeaway that every GDP should know."



"A lot of people in the community are asking about this — maybe we should turn it into a podcast or article."



Our founder works best with people who bring positive energy, communicate well, enjoy collaborating, take initiative, and genuinely love learning.



Here's what makes you a great fit:



• Qualified dentist with a strong clinical foundation (around 3+ years of experience preferred, although exceptional newer graduates are welcome to apply)

• Excellent written English

• Curious and passionate about continuous learning

• Able to explain complex clinical concepts in a clear and engaging way

• Organised and detail-oriented

• Responsive, reliable, and able to communicate clearly in a remote environment

• Proactive — you naturally spot opportunities and take action rather than waiting to be told what to do

• Enjoys interacting with other dentists and contributing thoughtfully to an online community

• Collaborative and happy to support teammates

• Comfortable receiving feedback and continuously improving

• Excited to explore AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to enhance your workflow



Bonus points if you've previously:



• Created educational social media posts

• Written dental or healthcare articles

• Created educational videos or online learning resources

• Managed or contributed to an online community

• Used tools such as Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI/content creation tools



About the Role



As our Clinical Content Dentist, you'll help create, repurpose, and support educational content across our podcast, YouTube channel, membership platform, website, and social media.



Your responsibilities may include:



• Turning podcast episodes into educational content, including podcast articles, clinical takeaways, summaries, and social media content

• Identifying standout sections from podcast episodes, webinars, and other educational content that could become YouTube videos, reels, carousels, or other formats

• Writing and contributing to podcast articles and other website content

• Creating educational carousel content from webinars, podcasts, research papers, and clinical discussions

• Summarising scientific literature and translating research into practical clinical takeaways

• Supporting the development and improvement of online courses, masterclasses, and other educational resources

• Reviewing clinical content for accuracy, clarity, and usefulness

• Contributing to our online dental community by responding to comments, questions, and member discussions

• Helping identify interesting questions, discussions, and recurring themes within the community that could inspire future content

• Engaging with dentists in a helpful, professional, and friendly way across our community platforms

• Working closely with the Founder and wider team on new educational projects and ideas

• Proactively spotting opportunities to improve, repurpose, or expand our existing content



The exact mix of responsibilities will evolve as you become more familiar with the business and your strengths become clear.



About the Position



• Part-Time: up to 20 hours/week or Full-Time: up to 40 hours/week, depending on your availability

• Remote position — work from anywhere

• Flexible schedule, provided you're responsive and available when needed

• Join a small, friendly international team that values curiosity, initiative, and great ideas

• Work closely with dentists and educators who are passionate about improving clinical education

• Opportunity to grow your role as the business continues to expand



How to Apply



To apply, please send an
 to 
 with:



• Your CV

• A short Loom/video telling us about your background and why this role interests you

• Examples of any educational content you've created (optional but encouraged)

• Your preferred arrangement (part-time or full-time)

• Your internet speed test screenshot (via speedtest.net)



Important: Use the word ONION in your
 subject line so we know you've read this far. Applications without this will NOT be considered.



We read every application carefully. If you love learning, enjoy explaining dentistry, like interacting with other dentists, and get excited about turning complex ideas into engaging educational content, we'd love to hear from you.



What Happens Next



We'll carefully review all applications and shortlist those who feel like a strong fit.



From there, our hiring process consists of three stages:



1. First Paid Test – a practical task where you'll transform a piece of clinical content into an educational format, so we can see how you think, communicate, and approach content creation.



2. Second Paid Test – a more in-depth project for shortlisted candidates.



3. Interview – a relaxed conversation with our Founder and/or Business Manager to get to know you, your experience, and how you like to work.



We value your time and effort, so both practical assessments are paid.

title: GIS Cartographer/GIS Specialist
description:
GIS Cartographer (Full-Time, Remote)

We are seeking a GIS Cartographer based in the Philippines to support GIS and mapping projects for our Australian team. This is a full-time remote role requiring availability during Australian business hours.

As a GIS Cartographer you will: 

• Produce clear, consistent, publication-quality figures for environmental management plans, approvals, clearing permits, EPA referrals and ecology survey reports.

• Run spatial analysis such as clearing footprints, buffers and overlaps with environmentally sensitive areas.

• Manage project spatial data in geodatabases, with tidy structures and metadata.

• Build and support field data capture in ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123, and process GPS data from site and survey teams.

• Source and manage WA data from DBCA, DWER and Landgate SLIP, working in GDA2020 and the right MGA zone.

• Work from our GIS intake system, agree scope and timing with project leads, and help improve templates and workflows.

About you

• Degree in GIS, spatial science, geography, environmental science or similar.

• Around 3 to 6 years of hands-on GIS experience, ideally in environmental consulting, infrastructure or resources.

• Advanced ArcGIS Pro and working QGIS skills.

• A portfolio of maps and figures for reports or approvals (please include a few examples).

• Confident with geodatabases, coordinate systems (GDA2020, MGA zones) and field data capture.

• Detail-minded, organised, and able to explain spatial information to non-GIS colleagues.

• Python or ArcPy, FME, drone or LiDAR processing, web GIS (ArcGIS Online, Experience Builder, Dashboards), or experience mapping ecological survey data will all help, but none are deal breakers.

Why Join Us

• Work that matters: your maps support decisions about clearing, habitat and environmental protection in WA.

• Variety: infrastructure, approvals, ecology surveys and standalone GIS projects.

• A B Corp that is assessed on how it treats people and the environment.

• Room to grow your skills in automation, web mapping and drone or LiDAR data as the practice grows.





Work Requirements

• Full-time position

• 36 hours per week

• Monday to Friday only

• Flexible working hours, provided agreed deadlines and deliverables are met

• Available for meetings and collaboration during Australian business hours when required

• Willing to use a time-tracking application

• Able to work independently and meet deadlines

How to Apply

Please
 the following to 

• Updated CV/Resume

• Short cover letter outlining: 

o Your GIS experience

o GIS software you have used

o Why you are a good fit for this role

• At least one example of GIS work completed using QGIS, ArcGIS, or a similar GIS platform (mandatory). This may include maps, project portfolios, spatial analysis outputs, dashboards, reports, or university projects. Any confidential information may be removed before submission.

• Expected hourly rate (AUD/hour)

• Earliest available start date

title: Residential HVAC Designer
description:
Company: HVAC 2 Home Performance®

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Lead Designer

Work Arrangement: Remote / To Be Discussed



Position Overview

HVAC 2 Home Performance® is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Residential HVAC Designer to support residential HVAC design projects across the United States. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Wrightsoft and a solid understanding of residential HVAC load calculations, equipment sizing, duct design, and construction documentation.



Key Responsibilities

- Prepare residential HVAC designs, layouts, and construction documentation.

- Perform heating and cooling load calculations using Wrightsoft in accordance with ACCA Manual J.

- Assist with HVAC equipment selection and sizing following ACCA Manual S.

- Design ductwork layouts, size ducts, and calculate airflow requirements following ACCA Manual D.

- Prepare room-by-room airflow schedules, equipment schedules, and HVAC design documentation.

- Review architectural plans, building specifications, and construction documents to develop accurate HVAC designs.

- Coordinate HVAC layouts with architectural, structural, and other building systems.

- Review and revise drawings based on project requirements, design reviews, and field conditions.

- Ensure designs align with applicable residential building codes, energy codes, and industry standards.

- Collaborate with the design team to maintain accuracy, consistency, and timely project delivery.



Qualifications

- Experience in residential HVAC design or mechanical design.

- Proficiency in Wrightsoft for residential load calculations and HVAC system design.

- Experience with energy modeling is preferred but not required.

- Familiarity with ACCA Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D.

- Understanding of residential HVAC systems, ductwork, airflow distribution, and equipment sizing.

- Ability to read and interpret architectural and mechanical drawings.

- Familiarity with U.S. residential building codes, including IRC, IMC, and IECC.

- Knowledge of building science, ventilation, indoor air quality, and HVAC performance verification is an advantage.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.

- Good written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaborate with a remote team.



What We're Looking For

We value designers who understand that successful HVAC design goes beyond equipment sizing. Our approach emphasizes accurate calculations, practical duct layouts, energy efficiency, and system performance. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, willing to learn, and committed to producing accurate, professional HVAC design documents.



Application Instructions

For questions or to submit an application, please contact 
 with your resume and a detailed cover letter.

title: Lead Specialist / Appointment Setter – US HVAC Company (GoHighLevel)
description:
About the role

ProThermal Heating & Cooling is a locally owned HVAC company in Tulsa, Oklahoma, serving homeowners across the Tulsa metro since 2019. We are hiring a full-time, remote Lead Specialist to own every incoming lead and turn it into a booked job.

The job is simple to explain and hard to do well. When a lead comes in through GoHighLevel, you respond within 5 seconds, connect with the customer, and get the job on the calendar. Speed and follow-through are everything in this role.

What you will do

Watch GoHighLevel all shift and respond to every new lead (calls, texts, form fills and web chats) within 5 seconds.

Call and text leads to understand the need and book the job: repair and service calls, tune-ups, memberships and free replacement estimates.

Follow up on every pending and unbooked lead daily until it is booked, closed or marked unqualified.

Rehash older leads and past customers by phone and text to fill open spots on the schedule.

Log every call, text, outcome and lead source in GoHighLevel.

Post every booking in the team Slack channel the moment it is made: customer name, service type, appointment time and lead source.

 a daily booking report to management at the end of every shift.

Flag recurring problems, objections or trends to management.

Contact only leads who have given consent, and honor every opt-out right away.

What you need

Equipment and setup (required)

Reliable high-speed internet. You must submit a speed test screenshot with your application and again whenever we ask. A backup connection (mobile data or pocket WiFi) is a plus.

A noise-cancelling headset with a clear microphone.

Your own computer or laptop that runs GoHighLevel, Slack and a browser smoothly at the same time.

Reliable power with a backup source (UPS, generator or inverter) so a brownout never takes you offline.

A quiet, dedicated place to work.

Experience and skills

2+ years in sales, appointment setting, telemarketing or call center work. US home services (HVAC) strongly preferred.

Excellent spoken and written English and a clear, friendly phone voice.

GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. You pick up any CRM quickly.

Comfortable working in Slack and sending clear
 reports.

Fast, organized and persistent. You can juggle several leads at once and hit daily booking goals.

Able to work full time during US Central Time business hours.

How you will be measured

Our standard is a 5-second response to every new lead. These are the numbers we review with you every day.



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include all five items below. We will not review applications that are missing any of them.

Start your message with this subject line: 5 SECONDS – Lead Specialist

Your resume, with your appointment setting or call center experience. Note any US home services or GoHighLevel work.

A screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net) taken at your workstation today, showing download, upload and ping.

A photo of your work setup showing your computer and headset.

A 1–2 minute voice recording. Introduce yourself, then show how you would respond to a homeowner who just requested an AC repair.

Have a question about the role? Include it with your application.

title: UGC Video Editor
description:
I'm Tony, a creator making short-form UGC ads for fitness, apparel, and lifestyle brands through Trybe. I'm looking for a reliable CapCut editor to turn my raw footage into clean, natural ads that brands can run on Meta.



Most videos are vertical talking-head videos or voiceovers with b-roll. I'll handle concepts, scripts, filming, final review, and submission. You'll handle editing and revisions based on the brief and references.



## The job, in order of importance



1. Cut mistakes, repeated takes, and dead space while keeping the voice natural and seamless. The intended first word should land immediately, with no dead air or stray frames at the start.

2. Add relevant b-roll, product overlays, and subtle zooms or keyframes that support the spoken message.

3. Add subtle sound effects when they fit, such as a mouse click on a product overlay. Keep them quiet enough that my voice stays clear, and export a clean vertical video at the requested settings.



I'll handle captions and music myself.



Each raw file is its own video unless I say otherwise. If I redo a sentence or ending, use the final take unless the brief specifies another one.



I care about clean execution and good judgment. Match the references and avoid unnecessary effects. Please watch your complete export before sending it.



## What I'm looking for



- Comfortable editing in CapCut.

- Experience with talking-head and voiceover/b-roll UGC ads.

- Good English for understanding the footage and communicating.

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle the footage.

- Detail-oriented, dependable, and open to feedback.

- Able to communicate through 
 and use Google Drive.

- Based in the Philippines or available for a compatible working schedule.

This is a part-time role with a one-month paid trial at $300 USD. If we both d

There will also be bonuses for content that performs well, paid on top of your base pay, with plenty of opportunities to earn more as we find winning ads together.



We'll agree on regular working days, start and end times, and a timezone based on your availability before we begin. We'll also agree on the number of videos per batch and set aside time for review and revisions within that schedule. The first two weeks will start with small batches while you learn my style.



I'll have all raw footage, the brief, and required assets uploaded to Google Drive before your agreed start time. Aim to have that day's agreed batch edited, exported, and uploaded to 02 To Be Reviewed around three hours after starting. There's flexibility on the exact timing, as long as I have enough time to review the videos and send any revision requests while you're still available during our agreed workday. Keep me updated if a batch needs more time so we can plan the handoff together.



Please include your working availability and how many videos you can reliably complete per workday while leaving time for review and revisions in your application.



Payment is planned through Wise on an agreed schedule. We can discuss further raises as the workload and responsibilities grow.



## How the work flows



1. Before your agreed start time, I upload the day's raw footage, a short brief, and all required assets to Google Drive, then message you in 
.

2. You edit using the brief, finished references, and supplied brand assets. Flag missing files or unclear instructions before proceeding.

3. Aim to upload the agreed batch to 02 To Be Reviewed around three hours after starting, with enough time left in the agreed workday for my review and any revision requests. Message me in 
 when the batch is ready.

4. I'll review while you're still available, send consolidated revision notes if needed, and move approved videos to 03 Approved.



Please keep raw footage, brand assets, and unposted work private.



Any unauthorized use, sharing, publishing, sale, or distribution of these materials, including use in a portfolio without my written permission, may result in immediate termination of our working relationship, subject to applicable law. No additional compensation will be due beyond amounts already earned or otherwise legally owed.

PAY



$7 to $10 USD per hour

Plus a $10 to $20 USD bonus for every inspection you book, with no cap

WHAT YOU'LL DO



Make 150 to 200 dials a day to homeowners

Ask a few quick questions about their roof and see if a free inspection makes sense

Clear, confident spoken English

Comfortable cold calling and hearing "no" without it ruining your day

Available full-time on Central time (CST)

A quiet workspace, your own headset, reliable internet, and ideally backup power

Organized enough to log every call and never miss a callback

Able to join video calls with our team on Google Meet

BONUS POINTS



Cold calling or appointment setting experience, especially in home services like roofing, solar, HVAC or remodeling

Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack or Google Sheets

You're funny

Roof Calendar is a small, fast-moving company that books appointments for roofing companies across the US. We're small enough that good people don't stay invisible. Performance > Seniority.

Read the full role overview:

title: Systems Analyst, Accounting & AI
description:
About the position 

Full time, Los Angeles business hours. Up to ₱350 per hour, paid for hours worked. If the hours or pay don't work for you, please don't apply.



About us



We are a property management company in Los Angeles. We run the business on our own software: leasing, maintenance, inspections, move-ins and move-outs, tenant and owner portals, staff hours, payroll and accounting. We build it with Claude, an AI that writes the code.



The role:

You run the day-to-day development of that software. You decide what needs building or fixing, instruct Claude, test the result, and make sure staff can use it.

You don't need to code. You do need to know accounting and how business systems are set up, well enough to spot when a number is wrong and find out why.

One hour it's a wrong label on a screen. The next it's an owner statement that won't balance. You report to the head of technology.



What you'll do:

Write clear instructions for Claude to build features and fix problems.

Test every change in our test environment before it goes live.

Take bug reports from staff, find the cause, get it fixed, and confirm with them.

Answer staff questions about the system using the actual records.

Keep the system documentation current.

Know how money moves: rent, owner payouts, management fees, vendor bills, security deposits, payroll, bank accounts.

When the bank, Buildium and owner ledgers disagree, find the reason and get it corrected.

Make sure no payment leaves the system without a person approving it.

You troubleshoot to the root cause, not the symptom.



Nice to have:

Daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot at work.

US property management accounting: owner statements, security deposits, trust reconciliations.

Business systems analyst or ERP consultant background.

Payroll experience (Gusto or similar).



What the first 90 days will look like:

Days 1-30: learn the software and how to work with Claude, starting with small fixes.

By day 90: own bug reports and staff questions end to end, shipping fixes across the system.



Requirements: 

Degree in accounting, finance or accounting information systems.

Solid accounting knowledge: reconciliations, AP and AR. Trust accounting a plus.

Experience setting up or running a business system: accounting software, ERP, CRM, or property management software (Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi).

Excellent written English.

Can juggle many tasks, from quick fixes to complex accounting questions.

No coding needed. SQL, advanced spreadsheets or automation experience a plus.

No 2025 or 2026 graduates.



Benefits:

Paid training

Work from home

Promotion path

Performance-based raises

Company Christmas gift

title: TikTok Product Video Editor – Faceless Content – $3/hour
description:
We are a small German e-commerce business looking for a reliable, creative video editor for ongoing freelance work.



Pay: USD 3 per hour. We agree on the hours and scope before each assignment. Start with one small paid test; no unpaid custom work. Long-term collaboration is our goal, but hours are not guaranteed yet.



We provide product B-roll, usually 2–5 minutes per product. Create 4–8 separately exported clips, approximately 5–20 seconds each and 50–70 seconds combined, plus a combined preview. Clips must work independently so we can rearrange them. Different products and categories keep the work varied.



Make faceless footage engaging with purposeful cuts, close-ups, zooms, speed ramps and slow motion where suitable. Unboxing should feel satisfying and energetic, with crisp mechanical clicks and movements. Keep original product sounds. NO MUSIC. Voiceover is added afterwards, so no voiceover synchronization is required.



Deliver vertical 9:16 MP4 files, preferably 1080x1920 when source quality allows, without watermarks, plus the editable project. Do not add unsupported product claims or paid assets.



We aim to build toward at least five finished videos daily using reusable modules and meaningful variations. This is a future production target, not guaranteed starting volume. Your role is editing, not filming, product research or account management.



APPLICATION TEST: Start with PRODUCT CUTS and answer these FOUR questions through OnlineJobs.ph:

1. Share two existing product/faceless videos you edited and explain your contribution.

2. How would you make a product video engaging without music or a face on screen?

3. Which software do you use, and how many paid hours would the package above realistically take? Confirm whether USD 3/hour works for you.

4. What are your weekly availability and turnaround time, and can you deliver separate clips and editable project files?



Please use your own concise answers. We value honest estimates, initiative and reliable communication.

title: Operations Assistant To The Founders
description:
OPERATIONS ASSISTANT TO THE FOUNDERS



Please read this whole page before you apply.



A NOTE FROM THE FOUNDERS

We run sales funnels and
 ads, and we are scaling hard. Today we're live in three markets: the UK, Italy and Israel. Soon we will test six new funnels per market, every single day. That's 18 funnels a day.



And that's only the start. Our systems are proven, and we're now pushing on to 10 different markets.



We don't do that with a big team. We do it with AI systems we built ourselves. We believe AI is the future: companies that don't operate AI-first will be beaten by companies that do. We intend to be the second kind.



But AI isn't perfect. Pages break. Ads launch with mistakes. Customer
s get answered badly. Someone has to keep an eye on all of it, catch what's wrong, and make sure it gets fixed. We're looking for that someone: our right hand.



WHY THIS JOB IS DIFFERENT

You won't sit in one department. You'll work directly with the founders and oversee three departments at once. Every day you'll cover the same responsibilities: customer service, funnels and ads. You'll see the whole business, not one small corner of it.



You're joining at the right moment. Every new market we open means more responsibility, more to learn, and more to earn for the people who are already here.



We will hire more people over time, but our goal is to stay as lean as possible. A small team moves faster, works smarter and costs less. Fewer people means more profit per person, and that's exactly why we can pay the people who grow with us far more than they would earn elsewhere.



You don't join us for an easy job. You join because you want to challenge yourself, find out what you're capable of, and grow. You'll learn more here in one year than you would anywhere else in five.



We are not a family. Companies that tell you that aren't being honest. Think of us as a small, dedicated team that plays to win. You work here because you enjoy doing your best work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Customer service: check and handle customer
s, and spot issues that keep coming back

- Funnels: check new pages, copy and checkouts before and after they go live

- Ads: monitor ad launches and catch problems before they cost money

- Spot what's broken or weak, flag it or fix it, and follow up until it's solved

- Work 1-on-1 with the founders from day one, and stay close to us as we grow



You don't need to create anything yourself. Our systems do the creating. Your job is to check, catch and follow through.



HOW WE'LL WORK TOGETHER

Overseeing several departments at once only works with a good routine. In your first weeks we'll sit down with you and build a working rhythm together: what you check every day, what you check every week, and how you report back to us. You won't have to figure that out alone.



HOW IT STARTS

- A paid trial month at $5/hour, part-time

- On day one you get clear goals and KPIs for that month

- Hit them, and we continue together, moving towards full-time with performance-based pay

- Don't hit them, and we part ways. No hard feelings, no drama

We won't hold your hand. The best people always find their own way, or tell us early when they're stuck.



WORKING HOURS

You work remotely, with at least 4 hours of overlap with European working hours each day.



WHAT WE VALUE

- Thinking for yourself. Don't just accept an idea because someone said it. Reason it through.

- Saying what you think. If something looks wrong, say so. Even to us.

- Ownership. A mistake you catch and fix is worth more than ten tasks done carelessly.

- Saying no. Not every idea is worth doing. Focus wins.

- The truth. What's real wins, not what sounds good.



WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT

- Formal communication. Be direct, be quick, be yourself.

- Years of experience. We care about how sharp you are and how fast you learn.

- Office politics. We're here to perform together, not to gossip.



WHO YOU ARE

- Excellent written English and a sharp eye for detail

- You notice when something "looks off", and you don't leave it there

- You're curious about many areas of a business and want to learn across all of them

- You love working with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)

- Comfortable with Google Sheets; experience with customer service, Shopify,
 Ads or funnels is a big plus



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "18 funnels a day" so we know you read this.

Then, in a few sentences: tell us about a time you caught a mistake that others missed.

Applications without this will not be read.



Is this you? Apply.

title: Work From Home Customer Operations Executive (SAP SD) | 6am to 2pm PHT, Mon to Fri
description:
SALARY

US$250 per week. Full-time.



HOURS

9:00am to 5:00pm Australian Eastern Time (AET), Monday to Friday.

That is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time now (Australian daylight saving), and 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April when daylight saving ends. No night shift.



ABOUT THE ROLE



A leading international apparel and headwear brand is hiring an experienced Customer Operations Executive for its wholesale customer-service team.



You will own wholesale orders from receipt to delivery in SAP SD, keep customers informed, and work with sales, logistics, warehouse and finance so every order is accurate and on time. This is a senior bar role. We want someone who takes ownership, builds their own reports, and can train or back up others in the team.



This role is customer operations only. It is not a supply planning, MRP or forecasting role.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Enter, change and manage wholesale customer orders in SAP SD, from order entry through delivery and invoicing (VA01 / VA02, deliveries, billing)

- Process and monitor EDI orders, and fix failed or rejected transactions (including IDocs)

- Track open orders, deliveries, backorders and stock delays

- Build and maintain open-order and delivery-status reports in Excel

- Update wholesale customers on orders and deliveries before issues become problems

- Resolve order discrepancies, short shipments, damaged goods and delivery issues

- Provide invoices, PODs and order acknowledgements

- Process returns and credits in line with company policy

- Handle product, pricing and account enquiries, and troubleshoot B2B platform issues

- Work closely with sales, sourcing, logistics, warehouse and finance

- Support and train other team members on processes and systems

- Help with eCommerce order enquiries when needed



MUST-HAVES



- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- 3+ years in B2B order management, wholesale customer operations or wholesale customer service

- Hands-on SAP SD sales order processing: order entry and changes, deliveries, billing and invoicing. Warehouse-only or inventory-only SAP experience is not enough

- Advanced Excel: XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and building open-order and delivery reports

- Experience leading, training or acting as backup for a small team

- Organised, detail-focused and proactive, and able to manage multiple deadlines without being chased

- Able to work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm AET, consistently



STRONGLY PREFERRED



- EDI order management (receiving, monitoring and fixing EDI / IDoc orders)

- Apparel, footwear or headwear industry experience

- Experience in wholesale, retail, FMCG, fashion or distribution

- Experience clearing credit blocks, delivery blocks or billing mismatches in SAP SD



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



- 97% or better order accuracy

- Orders entered within 48 hours of receipt

- Enquiries answered within 24 hours

- Delivery delays communicated before the due date

- Warehouse amendments handled promptly

- Full ownership of issues from start to resolution



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject line with COE-250 so we know you read the ad. Applications without it, or that skip the questions, will not be reviewed.



1. Attach your updated CV.

2. Answer all three questions below in your application.

3. Confirm your earliest start date and that you can work Mon to Fri, 9:00am to 5:00pm AET (6:00am to 2:00pm PHT now, 7:00am to 3:00pm PHT from April), at US$250 per week.



REQUIRED QUESTIONS



1. A wholesale sales order is blocked and will not create a delivery. Walk us through how you would diagnose and clear it in SAP SD. Cover at least: how you would find the block (which transactions or screens), whether it is a delivery block, credit block or incomplete data issue, the steps and t-codes you would use (for example VA02, VA03, V.23 or similar, VL01N), and how you would confirm the delivery and billing can proceed. If you have fixed a billing mismatch (invoice vs delivery / order qty or price), describe that instead with the same level of t-code detail.



2. It is 10:00am Australian Eastern Time. You have: (a) three EDI orders failing with IDoc errors that sales need fixed today, (b) a key wholesale account chasing a delayed delivery that ships tomorrow, and (c) your manager has just asked for an open-order status report for a call in 90 minutes. How do you prioritise, what do you do first, and how do you communicate upwards so nothing drops?



3. Describe a time you trained, coached or acted as backup for someone on order management or customer operations. What did you teach them, how did you hand over or cover their work, and what changed for the team as a result? Include team size and your role.



Fluent English is required.

description:

Analyze website and funnel performance to identify conversion bottlenecks and opportunities.

Develop a structured CRO roadmap and A/B testing strategy.

Build, launch, and manage A/B tests using Intelligems or similar experimentation platforms.

Test elements such as:

Pricing and offers

Bundles and quantity breaks

Subscription vs. one-time purchase offers

Product page layouts

Headlines, copy, CTAs, and creative

Upsells and cross-sells

Landing page structures

Determine appropriate test duration, sample size, and statistical significance.

Analyze test results beyond just CVR, including AOV, RPV, revenue, subscription take rate, and profitability.

Document learnings and recommend which winning tests should be rolled out.

Work closely with our media buying, creative, and development teams.

Continuously develop new testing hypotheses based on customer behavior and performance data.



Requirements

Proven experience in CRO and A/B testing for DTC/e-commerce brands.

Hands-on experience with Intelligems or similar tools.

Strong understanding of Shopify conversion funnels.

Experience testing pricing, bundles, subscriptions, PDPs, and landing pages.

Strong analytical skills and understanding of statistical significance.

Comfortable interpreting data and translating it into clear actions.

Able to show examples of previous tests and measurable improvements.

title: AI Video Editor (Full-Time)
description:
We are hiring a creative, hardworking, and highly trainable AI Video Editor to join our growing YouTube media company.



We produce faceless YouTube Shorts and long-form videos across various niches, including science, history, entertainment, and storytelling.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply generates AI videos using code or one-click automation tools.



We need someone who can take AI-generated footage and professionally edit it into entertaining, polished, high-retention videos.



More importantly, we want someone who listens carefully, follows instructions, accepts feedback, and is willing to learn and improve.



You do not need to be the world's best editor. We are happy to train the right person.



Responsibilities

Edit YouTube Shorts and long-form videos.

Generate AI footage using tools such as Google Veo, Kling, Runway, or similar platforms.

Combine AI footage, stock footage, music, and sound effects into engaging videos.

Follow scripts, creative directions, and editing guidelines accurately.

Make revisions based on feedback without unnecessary resistance.

Maintain strong pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.

Communicate regularly and meet production deadlines.

Continuously improve your editing skills and video quality.



Requirements

Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut Desktop, or similar software.

Basic experience with AI video generation tools.

Good understanding of video pacing and storytelling.

Ability to follow detailed instructions.

Willingness to learn new software, techniques, and editing styles.

Reliable internet connection and computer capable of video editing.

Strong communication skills.

Ability to work independently after receiving proper training.



The Attitude We Expect

Your attitude is just as important as your editing ability.

We are looking for someone who is:

Coachable: Accepts constructive criticism and applies feedback.

Humble: Willing to learn without being defensive or argumentative.

Reliable: Shows up on time, meets deadlines, and communicates properly.

Detail-oriented: Follows instructions instead of making unnecessary changes.

Hardworking: Takes responsibility and puts genuine effort into every video.

Adaptable: Can learn new editing styles and improve with guidance.

Respectful: Communicates professionally with management and teammates.



We provide clear instructions, examples, and feedback to help you succeed.



However, we expect you to take feedback seriously and implement improvements consistently.



We prefer a less experienced editor with an excellent attitude over a highly experienced editor who is difficult to work with.



What We DO NOT Want

Editors who argue over every correction or refuse to follow directions.

People who think they already know everything.

Applicants who are unwilling to learn or adapt.

People who rely entirely on automated AI video generation.

Editors who repeatedly ignore instructions.

Unreliable workers who disappear during working hours.



Salary, Profit Sharing & Growth

Starting salary: USD $3.50 per hour.

Working hours: 8 hours per day, 5 days per week.



Long-term, full-time remote position.



Profit sharing: Once the YouTube channel you work on becomes monetized and profitable, eligible editors will have the opportunity to earn a share of channel profits on top of their hourly salary.

Salary growth: Hourly pay may increase based on performance, skill development, and the channel's financial success.

Career growth: Opportunities to take on greater responsibilities as our YouTube media company expands.

We want our editors to grow financially as the channels grow. The more successful the channel becomes, the greater your potential earnings.



Profit-sharing terms and eligibility will be agreed upon separately.



How to Apply



Please submit:

Your video editing portfolio, preferably featuring AI-generated content.

The video editing software and AI tools you use.

Your previous editing experience.

Your computer specifications.

A short explanation of how you handle feedback and revisions.



Start your application with "READY TO LEARN" so we know you have read this job posting.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid editing test.



We are building a serious, long-term YouTube media company and want hardworking, respectful, and coachable people who are ready to grow with us.
