ABOUT US

We are an established sports placement and career development platform run by active professional athletes and industry specialists. We assist top talent in securing trials, contracts, and roster spots internationally through an extensive global network of club decision-makers, scouts, and sporting directors across [Redacted] countries.

Our target partners include independent 1-on-1 performance trainers, private high-performance academies, elite showcase operators, and regional talent media pages.

You will own top-of-funnel operations: researching target partners, executing structured multi-channel outreach, qualifying prospective partners, and booking high-intent alignment calls directly onto executive calendar schedules. You will also assist with onboarding newly signed partners and keeping our active partner network engaged ahead of key operational registration/transfer windows.

(Note: You will be building B2B relationships directly with coaches, trainers, and academy directors—you do not sell directly to individual athletes or run high-ticket consumer sales calls).

Solid understanding of competitive football (soccer) development pathways and leagues across international markets.

Direct hands-on experience navigating GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows, pipelines, and contact management.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

title: video editor
description:
We are a fast-growing eCommerce brand that produces high-volume Meta ads and is seeking an exceptionally skilled Paid Social Creative Editor who can produce AI-enhanced video ads and static creatives at scale. This role is for someone who understands direct-response marketing, fast-paced iteration, and AI generation workflows, not basic aesthetic editing. What you will do: 

Create high-volume paid social videos (UGC-style, product demos, problem–solution, voiceover visuals, testimonial edits). 

Generate AI-powered visuals using tools like: 

Google VEO 3 

Higgsfield 

Google Gemini 

AI UGC avatar tools 

AI image generators 

Build static ads using a mix of AI visuals + our existing asset library. 

Receive a creative brief (concept, angle, script) and independently produce: 

3–10 video variations 

5–20 static image variations 

Rapid iterations based on feedback and performance data 

Add engaging on-screen text, captions, VFX, and sound design. 

Incorporate our pre-existing footage + newly generated AI elements. 

Help conceptualize ideas that improve CTR, hook rate, thumbstop ratio, and ROAS. 

Deliver creatives in a Meta-native format (short form, mobile-first, bold text, fast pacing). 



Required Skills + Experience (please do not apply if you don't meet the criteria):



Direct-Response Creative Editing 

Knowledge of high-performing Meta ads formats 

Strong understanding of: Hooks, Pacing, Retention strategy, CTA placement AI Video & Image Generation (Advanced) 

Strong prompting abilities 

Ability to generate:, AI actors/UGC avatars, AI B-roll, AI product shots *

Workflow experience (storyboarding, prompt crafting, refining, upscaling) 

Technical Editing Software Skills 

Adobe Premiere Pro 

CapCut Desktop 

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro 

Photoshop, Canva, or Figma for static ads 

Ability to sync voiceovers and maintain pacing 

Paid Social Creative Knowledge 

Understanding of creative testing 

Ability to interpret creative performance metrics like: Hook rate, Thumbstop percentage, CTR, Watch-time dropoff 

Work Speed 

MUST be able to produce high-volume output daily 

Must be able to turn around creative requests within 24–48 hours 

English Proficiency 

Must be able to communicate verbally and over text proficiently in English



(SAY PROS)



### Additional Requirements



* **High-Level Editing Skills**



 * Strong professional editing skills beyond basic cuts and captions.

 * Excellent pacing, retention editing, sound design, motion graphics, VFX, transitions, and visual storytelling.



* **AI UGC**



 * Ability to generate realistic AI UGC, including AI actors, customer-style testimonials, expert-style videos, lifestyle scenes, and product-use footage.



* **AI Animation**



 * Experience creating AI-generated animations such as:



 * Medical/scientific animation

 * Motion graphics

 * 2D/3D-style animation

 * Cartoon/stylized animation

 * Mechanism/explainer visuals



* **AI-Generated B-Roll**



 * Ability to read a script and generate high-quality B-roll that directly matches each section of the script.

 * Must understand what visual should appear on screen to support the voiceover instead of using random filler footage.



* **Advanced Prompting**



 * Strong prompting skills for AI image and video generation.

 * Must understand start-frame/reference-image workflows, especially for Higgsfield.

 * Able to prompt for camera movement, character consistency, actions, environment, lighting, realism, product interaction, and scene continuity.

title: Shopify Developer — CRO & AOV Test Implementation
description:
We’re looking for a Shopify developer who can turn our conversion rate optimization (CRO) and average order value (AOV) ideas into reliable, ready-to-launch experiments.



We own the ideas, hypotheses, and priorities. You own the technical execution. Your role is to understand each test brief, flag technical limitations, build the experience, and make sure it works properly across devices.



What you’ll do



- Implement CRO and AOV tests across product pages, landing pages, collection pages, and the cart.

- Build and modify Shopify sections, templates, and reusable components.

- Execute ideas such as bundles, quantity breaks, upsells, cross-sells, free-shipping progress bars, sticky add-to-cart buttons, and offer messaging.

- Set up test variants in our testing platform and verify that targeting and tracking work correctly.

- Integrate and customize apps where needed, recommending custom development when it’s the better fit.

- QA each test across mobile and desktop, checking product variants, discounts, cart behavior, and key purchase journeys.

- Protect site speed and existing functionality when shipping changes.

- Roll out winning tests, remove losing variants, and keep the codebase organized.



What we’re looking for



- AI first (utilizing all the latest ai tools to help with your output)

- Strong hands-on Shopify development experience.

- Confidence with Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Shopify themes, and Online Store 2.0.

- Experience implementing ecommerce experiments or conversion-focused storefront changes.

- Familiarity with A/B testing tools, analytics events, and tracking validation.

- Strong mobile implementation skills and attention to visual detail.

- An understanding of Shopify’s checkout, discount, and app limitations.

- Clear communication, realistic delivery estimates, and dependable follow-through.



How we’ll work



You’ll receive a test brief outlining the idea, intended customer experience, and success metric. You’ll clarify implementation details, estimate the work, build the test, and provide a preview for review before launch.



You should be comfortable working from a clear brief without always needing a pixel-perfect design. We expect you to flag edge cases and suggest practical implementation improvements while staying focused on the test.



What success looks like



- Tests move from brief to launch quickly and reliably.

- Implementations match the intended customer experience.

- Tracking is validated before launch.

- Changes work smoothly on mobile and desktop.

- Bugs, performance regressions, and unnecessary complexity are kept to a minimum.



You’ll be measured on execution quality, delivery speed, and reliability—not whether every hypothesis wins.



To apply, please fill-in this application form: 



Please fill-in the "Additional Information" section:



- Two or three relevant Shopify projects and what you personally built.

- An example of a CRO or AOV experiment you implemented.

- Your availability

title: Finance Manager (Daily Reporting)
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO.



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not.

We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.

The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET):

• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.

Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team

Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger

What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

• Ecommerce or inventory based business experience

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You have built cash flow models yourself

• Comfortable reconciling data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, payment gateways and 3PL reports

• Multi currency and multi entity experience

• Reliable to a fault. A pack that lands 6 days out of 7 is worth a fraction of one that lands 7

• Willing to work a 7 day rhythm with light weekend days, and to cover Philippine public holidays

• Excellent written English and the confidence to tell a CEO a number he will not like

Strong Plus

• Beauty, cosmetics or CPG experience

• Experience reporting for a Western or European company from the Philippines

• BI or automation skills (Looker Studio, Power BI, SQL, Zapier or similar)

• Familiarity with NL and US cross border reporting

• Xero, QuickBooks or a comparable cloud ledger



First 90 Days Looks Like Success If

1. The daily pack has landed every day for 30 consecutive days and leadership trusts it

2. A 13 week rolling cash forecast is live, updated weekly, and reliable enough to make decisions on

3. True landed COGS and contribution margin are known per SKU and per channel

4. The daily pack takes under 45 minutes to produce because the rest is automated



What We Offer

• Fully remote, permanently

• Direct access to the CEO

• Genuine ownership of the finance function as it grows

• HMO health coverage and 13th month pay

• Paid monthly via Wise



What to Include in Your Application

• Your CPA registration number, or the equivalent qualification with the body that issued it

• One management report you built yourself, redacted as needed, so we can see the format and the metrics you chose

• The names of the systems you have reconciled across, and for which business

• Confirmation in writing that you are available on a 7 day rhythm

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.

title: Simpro & Admin Support VA with basic bookkeeping capability
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on Simpro experience, ideally in HVAC, handyman or responsive maintenance, and clear, confident spoken English will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian electrical, air conditioning and maintenance business needs a part-time Simpro and admin VA to keep the back office running on the days the current office admin isn’t in, and gradually take over the Simpro workload so she can focus on bookkeeping. The core of the role is phones,
, job and quote creation, scheduling, purchase orders and invoice preparation in Simpro, plus verifying the team’s hours against what is being charged to customers. Capability to cover team and supplier payments in Xero down the track is also wanted, in case the business grows into two VAs. A website refresh is a nice-to-have.



The key challenge is consistency in a business that currently has none. The right person will bring structure rather than wait for it, push the owners for answers when needed, and treat the business like their own. The owners want someone who says “our business” and sees this as their dream role.



Success looks like no missed calls or
s on the office admin’s days off, Simpro being used properly (and better than it is today), accurate invoices that match actual hours worked, and a VA who has outgrown the four hours and is ready to move to full-time.



What You’ll Own



Phones & Customer Communication



Answer inbound calls during working hours

Return missed calls from the days the office admin isn’t in, starting with the previous day’s calls

Check and respond to
s in the admin inbox, reading the full
 trail before replying

Capture every enquiry so nothing gets missed between shifts

Where an owner can’t be reached, call the customer back to let them know when they will hear from the team



Jobs, Quotes & Scheduling (Simpro)



Take enquiry details over the phone (what the customer needs, scope, site details) and enter them into Simpro

Create new jobs and quotes in Simpro

Prepare rough estimates for straightforward jobs (e.g. adding a downlight, installing an air con), using ChatGPT on the enquiry notes

Schedule site visits for the owners where a job needs to be looked at before quoting

Schedule jobs and quotes for the field team

Attach and raise purchase orders

Keep Simpro job notes up to date

Prepare invoices in Simpro, ready for approval and sending



Client Portals



Transfer job photos and information from Simpro into large clients’ own portals to submit invoices and job records

Learn each client portal as it comes up; no prior experience needed



Team Hours & Payments



Verify team hours by cross-referencing the Simpro schedule, actual hours completed, and timesheets in Xero

Check who has or hasn’t checked in and out, and message the team to confirm finish times

Flag any mismatch between hours charged to the customer and hours booked on timesheets, so invoices are accurate

Pay the team and suppliers in Xero (future scope)



Systems & Documentation



Set up Simpro Phone so the business number diverts and calls can be answered virtually

Document each task as an SOP as it is handed over

Become the Simpro champion in the business: use the training videos and in-app help, and suggest setups or shortcuts that make workflows easier

Explore moving team timesheets from Xero into Simpro if possible



Team Rhythm & Accountability



Send a morning WhatsApp message with the day’s priorities, and an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing approval

Help get planned weekly team meetings running: book them, send reminders, and prepare the list of items to cover

Follow up the owners when waiting on an answer (e.g. chase again after 48 hours)



Desirable / Later Stage



Refresh the business website (currently believed to be on Wix), keeping the existing domain and platform where possible

First website job: review the “free quote” button and how quotes are positioned

Over time, potentially take on blogs, SEO and visibility on Google and AI search



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Hands-on Simpro experience, ideally in HVAC, handyman or responsive maintenance

If not Simpro, general trades admin experience across the full workflow: lead, quote, schedule, job, invoice

Experience with quoting, invoicing, scheduling and purchase orders

Basic bookkeeping experience is a bonus for possible future needs (BAS and compliance stay with the accountant)

Website building or redesign experience (Wix preferred) is a nice-to-have, not a must



Communication Skills



Clear spoken English for calls

Confident answering phones and making outbound calls to customers

Strong written English for
s



Technical Proficiency



Simpro: job creation, scheduling, quoting, invoicing and POs, with the ability to go beyond the basics and improve its setup, or keenness to learn

Familiar with Xero

Comfortable with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel)

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT) to support estimates and admin

Open to learning client portals



Organisational Skills



Manages calls,
s, scheduling and paperwork within a four-hour daily shift

Keeps track of missed calls and open items across the days

High attention to detail in job records, quotes and invoices



Non-Negotiables



Task creator, not a task ticker: finds useful work during downtime

Brings ideas to the team and isn’t afraid to push the owners for answers or book time with them

Says when they can’t get something done, when they’re at capacity, or when they’re not busy enough

 trail before replying

Owner mindset: treats the business as “our business” and wants to grow with it, potentially into full-time

Comfortable in a business that is still building its routines

Self-driven learner who teaches themselves Simpro features, client portals and more



Working Arrangements

A stated path to full-time as the role outgrows the four hours

Owners who value your input, want you to push them for answers, and see this as a long-term role

title: Project Manager / Account Manager - Established SEO & Web Agency | $1,500-$2,000/month
description:
We're an established SEO and web agency, operating for eight years and working with UK and European businesses. We're looking for an experienced project manager to keep client work moving, make sure it's done properly, and take real ownership of the results.



This is not a "follow the checklist" role. I want someone who notices when something looks wrong, works out why, and either fixes it or comes to me with a recommendation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage delivery across a portfolio of client accounts: new content, content updates, social posts, monthly checks and website care.

- Manage website projects from an agreed design through build, testing and launch, including hands-on WordPress editing and troubleshooting.

- Run SEO audits using our tools and processes, investigate the findings, and bring me clear recommendations.

- Review all work against the brief before it reaches me or a client.

- Dig into client data (Google Search Console, GA4, rankings), tell me what it's saying and what we should do next.

- Write clear client
s, with me copied in.

- Handle routine jobs: research, uploads, indexing requests, plugin updates and form tests.

- When you have spare time, use your initiative: go through client data, find opportunities and bring me ideas.



YOU MUST HAVE

- 3+ years managing multiple client accounts or projects at an SEO, web or digital marketing agency.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll write to UK clients and join calls.

- Confidence in WordPress: editing pages, basic HTML/CSS. Technical curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools quickly.

- Working knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4.

- Confidence using AI assistants to get work done, checking their output and spotting mistakes. Be ready to show us an example.

- Reliable internet, backup power and a quiet place for calls.



DETAILS

- Full-time: 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, eight hours per day.

- You must be available during our core overlap hours: 4pm-10pm Manila time (3pm-9pm from late March to late October). 



The remaining two working hours per day can be agreed with you.

- $1,500-$2,000 USD a month, depending on experience (approximately $8.65-$11.54/hour based on a 40-hour week). Long-term contractor role.

- Shortlisted applicants do a short paid trial on a real task.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word CHECKED so I know you've read this far. Then answer each question below. Specific examples beat long answers. I'll ask you about them on the call.



A Loom video is required. Applications without a Loom video won't be considered.



1. How many client accounts have you managed at once, for how long, and what did you personally do (not your team)?

2. Tell me about a time a tool, a team member or an AI got something wrong and you caught it. How did you notice, and what did you do?

3. Record a Loom video of no more than three minutes, speaking in English, showing something you personally built, fixed or improved. Explain the problem, what you did and the result. We use this to assess both your work and spoken English. Include the Loom link in your application and make sure we can view it. Remove confidential client details.

4. A client's Google organic traffic dropped 30% last month. What do you check first, in order?

5. What's the most technical thing you've done in WordPress yourself?

6. Can you work 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, including the core overlap hours above? What other work do you currently have?

7. Your expected monthly pay in USD and your earliest start date.

We are modernising our back office around an integrated Microsoft 365 and SharePoint environment, supported by AI tools (Claude), to make document management, compliance tracking and client administration faster and easier to scale.

The Role

We are looking for a capable, trustworthy Office Administrator who is also comfortable handling the firm's everyday IT. Around 70% of the role is administration: supporting our lawyers, onboarding clients and keeping our remote operations running smoothly. The other 30% is hands-on IT support across Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Claude, our AI assistant.

You don't need to be a developer or IT engineer. We want an organised administrator who understands the basics of IT, picks up new tools quickly, and will grow with the firm as our systems develop.

Key Responsibilities

Office Administration (around 70%)

• Support onboarding of new clients and lawyers: gathering documents, setting up files and coordinating details

• Schedule meetings across time zones and manage shared inboxes professionally

• Assist lawyers with day-to-day admin (formatting, requests, follow-ups) and coordinate with vendors and service providers

• Keep the firm's SharePoint/OneDrive filing in order: set up new client and matter folders using our naming conventions and keep the master list of client and matter codes up to date

• Maintain the library of current templates (letters of engagement, terms of business, policies) so lawyers always use the latest version

• Track expiry of key documents (trade licences, IDs, KYC/AML documents) and flag upcoming renewals

IT Support (around 30%)

• Set up user accounts, shared mailboxes, folder access and work devices in Microsoft 365

• Help staff with everyday Outlook, OneDrive, Teams and MFA issues, and support the firm's MFA and access-control rollout

• Be the first point of contact for staff questions on using Claude, and help roll out the firm's AI Use Policy

About You

• Prior experience in an administrative or virtual office support role (legal industry preferred)

• Some hands-on IT experience, such as setting up users, managing shared folders or mailboxes, or troubleshooting everyday issues; no coding or advanced technical skills needed, and training is provided on our systems and security practices

• Comfortable with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Teams) and quick to pick up new tools

• An interest in, and ideally some experience with, AI tools such as Claude

• Excellent written and spoken English (non-negotiable)

• Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and comfort working to strict file-naming and folder conventions

• Follows instructions reliably with minimal supervision, while anticipating needs and taking initiative

• Discreet and trustworthy with confidential client data

Nice to have

• A degree or certification in IT, Information Systems or a related field

• Familiarity with a practice/matter management system (e.g. Lexzur or similar)

• Exposure to compliance or AML concepts

Working Arrangements & What We Offer

• Fully remote, with fixed hours of 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UAE time, Monday to Friday (the UAE timezone requirement is non-negotiable)

• A stable internet connection and a professional remote setup are required

• Weekend work is not expected; if an occasional request comes through, a quick reply confirming receipt and when you'll follow up is appreciated

• A paid 3–5 day trial before any long-term engagement is confirmed

• Direct mentorship from the Managing Partner and senior Operations team, plus hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint architecture and enterprise AI tools

• Scope for the role to grow as the firm's technology and AI adoption expands

title: AI Solutions Engineer – Software, Systems & AI Automation
description:
JOB TITLE: AI Solutions Engineer – Software, Systems & AI Automation

COMPANY: Ashlex LLC

LOCATION: Philippines (Remote)

TYPE: Part-time initially, with long-term / full-time potential

EXPERIENCE: Strong mid-level technical generalist or above

COMPENSATION: Negotiable, based on experience and demonstrated ability



ABOUT ASHLEX



Ashlex is a US-based company providing technology consulting, custom software development, hosting, business management, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. We develop applications and internal tools, integrate commercial software, maintain infrastructure, and support clients in different industries.



We actively use AI tools including Codex, ChatGPT, and other LLMs to help us develop solutions faster and work more effectively.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a technically strong, resourceful, creative person who knows how to use AI to solve real business and technology problems.



This is NOT an entry-level role, and we're NOT looking for someone whose only technical skill is prompting AI to generate code. A solid, hands-on technical background is essential. You should understand programming, Linux, servers, databases, APIs, networking fundamentals, troubleshooting, and how applications actually work.



You don't have to know every tool or language. You must be able to understand and verify AI-generated work, identify mistakes, investigate unfamiliar problems, make sensible technical decisions, and finish assignments.



The work is varied. One day you might build an application. The next you might troubleshoot a Linux server, plan a technical project, design a dashboard, connect APIs, automate a workflow, research a new product, or improve an existing business system.



You will work closely with our Founder and CEO. Over time, a successful candidate may grow into broader technical leadership. We are looking for a builder and problem solver first, not someone seeking an executive title immediately.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



AI, automation and general problem solving

- Use Codex, ChatGPT, and other approved AI tools productively and responsibly.

- Research, prototype, evaluate, and implement technical solutions.

- Create integrations, scripts, automations, and internal tools.

- Identify practical ways AI can improve development and operations.

- Check AI output for accuracy, security, reliability, and maintainability.



Software development

- Build and maintain custom web applications and business systems.

- Work with existing codebases as well as modern technologies.

- Develop APIs, database integrations, and web interfaces.

- Troubleshoot, test, document, and improve software.

- Use Git, Docker, and structured development workflows.



Systems administration and troubleshooting

- Assist with Linux server and hosting administration.

- Diagnose application, web server, network, database, and deployment issues.

- Help with updates, configurations, backups, monitoring, and reliability improvements.

- Collaborate with our existing systems administrator.

- Follow approved procedures for production and security-sensitive changes.



Design and user experience

- Create or improve website layouts, dashboards, forms, and application interfaces.

- Build responsive, usable interfaces and prototypes.

- Work with designers and WordPress developers when specialized help is needed.

- Use good visual judgment and AI-assisted creative tools appropriately.



Planning and delivery

- Turn business needs into implementation plans and manageable tasks.

- Research options, estimate effort, and identify dependencies and risks.

- Communicate progress and raise blockers early.

- Coordinate handoffs with developers, operations, and independent QA.

- Take assignments through testing, documentation, and completion.



REQUIRED

- Strong hands-on technical experience with software development and troubleshooting.

- Practical understanding of web applications, APIs, SQL databases, and server fundamentals.

- Linux and general system administration familiarity.

- Practical experience using AI tools for technical work, with the judgment to check their output.

- Ability to learn unfamiliar codebases and technologies.

- Strong independent problem solving, organization, and follow-through.

- Clear written English and some overlap with New York business hours.



USEFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED

- JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Perl, or other languages.

- PostgreSQL/MySQL, Docker, Git, cloud hosting, and Linux administration.

- WordPress, n8n, CRM/helpdesk systems, and workflow automation.

- UI/UX tools such as Figma and graphic design experience.

- LLM APIs, AI agents, integrations, and technical project planning.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are curious, technically grounded, comfortable with variety, and willing to learn. You don't give up just because a problem is new. You ask good questions, use AI thoughtfully, explain your decisions, and finish what you start. You care about a tested, working result—not simply producing code or reports.



WORKING WITH US



This role begins with a paid part-time trial. Long-term hours and compensation will depend on results, business needs, and mutual fit. We work on New York time and require some schedule overlap, but can be flexible.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. A short introduction describing your technical experience.

2. Two or three projects you personally contributed to, explaining your actual role.

3. Which AI tools you use and how you verify their output.

4. An example of a difficult technical problem you solved independently.

5. Your hands-on experience with Linux, systems administration, databases, and software development.

6. Your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and New York time overlap.



Please don't send a generic AI-generated cover letter. We actively encourage using AI, but want to understand your own experience and judgment.



Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid assessment involving AI-assisted development, troubleshooting, planning, and communication.



If you enjoy solving practical problems, building useful technology, and using AI to accomplish more, we'd like to hear from you.





**IMPORTANT – APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS**



**PLEASE APPLY ONLY THROUGH THIS JOB POSTING.**



Do not contact me through personal social media, private messaging,
, or any other personal accounts.



**Anyone who attempts to bypass the application process by contacting me directly through personal channels will be automatically disqualified, and their application will not be reviewed.**



Please respect this requirement and follow the application instructions. Thank you.

title: AI Video Automation Builder: Turn Ad Scripts Into Finished Videos Automatically
description:
We're a US direct-to-consumer supplement brand with every ad made by AI. Right now editors do each step by hand. We want someone to build a system that takes an approved script and outputs a finished, launch-ready video ad with minimal human touch.



**What you'll build**

A pipeline, owned by us and living in our repo, that goes from script to finished ad:

- **Breakdown:** splits the script into scenes and shots, and writes the prompts for each one

- **Visuals:** generates consistent characters and scenes through APIs (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, Magnific or similar)

- **Voice and music:** voiceover and lip-sync through ElevenLabs, and songs for music ads through Suno

- **Edit:** assembles the cut automatically with captions, sound effects, product shots and the offer card (FFmpeg, Remotion or similar)

- **Delivery:** outputs 9:16 and 4:5 versions straight to a Google Drive folder, ready to launch

- **Fixes:** handles revisions by re-running only the shots that changed



The formats it needs to handle are drama ads (1 to 4 minute AI story ads with recurring characters), song ads made with Suno, and doctor or talking-head explainers.



**You're a fit if you**

- Have already built an automated or agent-driven video pipeline (show us what it outputs)

- Write code: Python or Node, API integrations, and agent tools like Claude Code

- Understand what makes a direct-response ad work, not just how to render one, and can judge your own output

- Document what you build so it keeps running without you



**Deal**

A project fee to build the first working version, then a monthly retainer to run and improve it. Bonus when ads from the pipeline become top spenders. Everything you build, including code, prompts and workflows, belongs to us and lives in our accounts. 



**How to apply**

1. Show us a pipeline you've built: a screen recording or repo walkthrough, plus 2 to 3 videos it produced.

2. In a few lines, tell us how you'd keep a character looking the same across 20 shots.

3. Paid test: we give you one of our scripts, and you show it running through your setup to a finished ad in 24 hours.



Applications without a working example won't be reviewed.
